upamā₁ [f. upama] f. comparison; resemblance
white | similarity | lit. [alamkāra] synonym; rhet. metaphor, simile; Kālidāsa is renowned for its use — ifc. similar to, resembling, like, such as (iic.). amaropamā amn like an immortal.
upamādhvani | dhvani | m. lit. suggestion of a comparison.
upamāprapañca [prapañca] m. lit. [alaṃkāra] metaphorical use.
upamārtha [artha] m. reason for a resemblance; meaning of an image. upamārthena adv. figuratively.

upamāna [instr. upamā₁] n. standard of comparison; object of a comparison; opp. upameya | phil. [Nyāya] identification, one of the 4 means of legitimate knowledge [pramāṇa]. upamānopameyabhāva gram. relation of analogy or comparison. upamitikaranam upamānam [Tarkasamgraha] Identification is the efficient cause of analogical knowledge.
upamānapūrvapada [pūrvapada] n. gram. com pose determinative [karmadhāraya] whose left constitutive is a comparison (like analosna).
upamānabahuvrīhi [bahuvrīhi] m. gram. adjectival compound (exocentric) of comparison.
upamānottarapada [uttarapada] n. gram. compound karmadhāraya whose right constituent is a comparison (like puruṣavyāghra).
upamānopameyabhāva [upameyabhāva] m. relation tion between the comparator and the compared; analogy.
upamita [pp. upamā₁] amnf upamitā comparative.

upamiti [act. upamā₁] f. comparison; resemblance, similarity; analogy | phil. [Nyāya] knowledge by identification; cf. upamāna — obj. f. phil. that which is identified. samjñāsamjñisambandhajñānam upamitih [Tarkasamgraha] Knowledge by identification is the knowledge of the relationship between a noun and its denotation.
upamitibhava | bhava | mr. phil. feeling of identification.

Upamitibhavaprapañcakathā [prapañcakathā₁] f. lit. np. of the Upamitibhavaprapañcakathā or Upa mitibhavaprapañcā "Tale on the feeling of identification", didactic allegory of the Jain scholar Siddharși (906); in it he describes the amusements of citizens in a park on the occasion of the spring festival, and their amorous games.
upameya [pfp. [1] upamā₁] amnf Upa meyā comparable with (i. iic.) — n. bed. subject of a comparison; opp. upamāna; cf. rūpaka.
upayantṛ [agt. upayam] m. spouse.
upayam [Upayam] v. [1] pr. (upayacchati) pp. (upayata) to marry.
upayā [Upayā₁] v. [2] pr. (upayāti) pp. (upayāta) to approach, to arrive; to come to such a state.
upayāta [pp. upayā ] amnf upayātā who approached; came, arrived — n. arrival.
upayukta [pp. upayuj] amnf upayuktā employed, used; consumed | applicable, useful; just; worthy of.

upayuj [Upayuj₁] v. [7] pr. r. (upayunkté) pp. (upayukta) to appropriate; to undertake; to care for, to adhere to, to be devoted to | to enjoy, to use, to employ someone — ps. (upayujyate) to be employed, to be used; to be useful to — ca. (upayojayati) to employ, to use.

upayoga [act. upayuj] m. employment, use; utilization; utility | consumption, enjoyment; acquisition (not. of knowledge) | phil. [Nyāya] causa lity. upayogam gam to be used, to be employed. upayogam vraj to serve.
upayogi iic. upayogin.
upayogitā [tā] f. applicability, usefulness; relevance. bruvate hi phalena sādhavo na tu kamthena nijo )8 payogitām Good people prove their usefulness by their actions, not by their words.
upayogitva |tva| n. id.
upayogin [agt. upayuj] amnf upayo ginī suitable, useful; usable, appropriate, relevant.
úpara |upara| amnf uparā under; posterior; near — m. soc. stone supporting the millstone at soma.
uparakṣa |uparakṣa| m. bodyguard.
uparakṣaṇa [uparakṣaṇa] n. guard; outpost.
uparata [pp. uparam] amnf uparatā ceased, discontinued | indifferent; disappeared, deceased. uparatastatrabhavān devadattaḥ the respected Deva datta has passed away.

uparati [act. uparam] f. repose; contemplation | death | phil. [Vedānta] contemplation, one of the 6 cardinal virtues [satsampad]; its practice implies the cessation of all duties concerning one's cries.
uparatna | uparatna | n. semi-precious stone; not. gomeda hyacinth, pusyarāga topaz, vaidūrya cat's eye and pravala coral.
uparam [uparam] v. [1] pr. r. (uparamate) pp. (uparata) to cease, to rest, to stop; to abstain from, to renounce (abl.).

uparama [act. uparam] m. cessation, stop, expiration; abstention | abandonment, withdrawal | phil. [Vedānta] renunciation of the world, one of the 6 required aptitudes [saṭkasampatti] of the aspirant to liberation [adhikārin].

upári [related to upa] adv. above; moreover, furthermore; after | above, beyond (acc. loc. g. abl.); after (abl.) | about, opposite, with regard to (g.) — ifc. on (iic.) || gr. ; lat. super; ang. over; all. über. uparyupari adv. far above; higher and higher. upariyupari grāmam very near the village. upari śailam gam climb the mountain. muhūrtādupari adv. after a minute. bhavanopari above the house, on the roof. kailāsaśikharopari adv. at the top of Mount Kailāsa. upari payah pibet adv. then one must drink milk. uparyupari sarveṣām atiṣṭhat he stood far above all.

Uparicara [cara] m. myth. [Mah.] np. of Uparicara "who travels in the air" (with the air chariot given to him by Indra), epithet of King Vasu of the Cedi country; his wife is Girikā, who bore him five sons, including Brhadratha; one spring day when the Queen was indisposed, he went hunting in the forest and ejaculated, which he entrusted to a kite, but it fell into the Yamuna and was eaten by the fish nymph Adrikā; in her womb were found Matsya₁ gandhī (later Satyavatī) and his brother Matsya₁; Indra gave him an eternally fresh garland |vaijayantīmālā|, protecting him from all harm as long as he wore it; as well as a bam staff

bou [venudanda] to plant in the ground to celebrate the festival of Indra [indrotsava], which he instituted; he built a great empire, was a friend of Indra and Garuda, a devotee of Vishnu, an influential member of Yama's council, and he finally ascended to the heaven of Brahma.
uparibhumi | bhūmi | adv. above the ground.
uparimartya | martya | amnf uparimartyā over human — m. superman ["above mortals"].
upáriṣṭāt [tāt] adv. up; from above | behind; opp. purastāt | later (to ⟨abl.⟩). tata upariștāt subsequently to this. upariṣṭha var. upariṣṭha [stha] amnf upariṣṭhā which stands above, situated on.
uparudh [uparudh₂] v. [7] pr. (uparuṇaddhi) pp. (uparuddha) to block, stop, hinder, obstruct, prevent; to besiege.
uparudha [pp. uparudh] amnf uparudhā blocked, stopped, prevented.
uparūpaka |uparūpaka| n. bed. minor genre of theater.
uparodha [act. uparudh] m. hindrance, block cage, obstruction, obstacle | trouble; insult.
uparodhana [act. uparudh] n. hindrance, blockage, obstruction, obstacle.
upala [upara] m. stone, rock | precious stone, jewel — f. cf. upalā || fr. opal.
upalabhagnanālikerarasasnigdhaśilātalam [K.] The floor slabs were greasy with the juice of the coconuts that had burst on the striking stones.

upalakṣ [upalakṣ] ca. (upalakṣayati) pp. (upalakṣita) pfp. (upalakṣya) to observe; to perceive; to pay attention to | to consider as; to evaluate; to distinguish; to indicate, to designate; to imply — ps. (upalaksyate) to be observed; to be designated.

upalakṣaṇa [act. upalakṣ] n. act of observing; designation; implication | indicator | gram. qualifying transitory, occasional or indirect property (opp. viśesana) | lit. metaphorical usage; implication; synecdoche; not. implication of multiple analogous objects where only one is specified. kākebhyo dadhi raksyatām Protects the curd from ani evils (and not just from crows).
upalakṣaṇatā [tā] f. phil. [Nyāya] the state of being an indicator.
upalakṣaṇatva [vat] n. id.
upalakṣita [pp. upalakṣ] amnf upalakṣitā observed; perceived; looked at; estimated | characterized, marked, distinguished | included, involved | phil. expressed by implication; implied; understood.
upalaksya [pfp. [1] upalaks] amnf upalakṣyā to be understood by implication, inferable.
upalabdha [pp. upalabh] amnf upa labdhā grasped; understood; perceived, recognized.

upalabdhi [act. upalabh] f. attainment, acquisition, gain; success | observation, perception; awareness | understanding, knowledge | the state of being perceptible. garbhasya upalabdhi conception. padārthā abhisambandhasyopalabdhih bhavati
vākye [MB.] In the sentence, we perceive the relationship between the meanings of the words.
upalabdhimat [mat] amnf upalabdhimatī who perceives, who understands | perceptible, intelligible.

upalabh [upalabh] v. [1] pr. r. (upalabhate) pp. (upalabdha) to take, to seize, to grasp; to obtain, to hold | to perceive, to understand, to recognize — ca. (upalambhayati) to cause to be obtained; to cause to be understood.
upalabhya [pfp. [1] upalabh] amnf upa labhyā which can be obtained, to be taken; attainable, perceptible, understandable, intelligible — abs. ind. having obtained, having perceived.
upalambh [ca. upalabh] v. [10] pr. (upa lambhayati) to make obtain; make people understand.
upalambha [act. ca. upalabh] m. obtaining perception, understanding; recognition.
upalambhaka |agt. ca. upalabh| amnf upalambhakā that obtains | that perceives | that makes perceived; that recalls.
upalambhana [act. That. upalabh] n. rapid perception; intelligence.
úpalā [f. upala ] f. movable millstone (upper stone of a mill, resting on its base [dṛṣad]) | refined sugar.
upalip [upalip] v. [6] pr. (upalimpáti) pp. (upalipta) to coat, anoint; to soil; to spread, smooth (not. dung [gomaya]).
upavañcana [upavañcana] n. wobbly approach.
upavad [upavad] v. [1] pr. (upavadati) to speak ill of; to insult | to speak to, to address oneself to — pr. r. (upavadate) to flatter, to win over; to cajole, to put in one's game.
upavana [upavana] n. undergrowth; grove.
upavarn [upavarn] v. [10] pr. (upavarnayati) to describe, to detail, to recount.

Upavarṣa [upavarṣa] m. hist. np. of Upavarṣa, son of Sankarasvāmī, philosopher of Mīmāṃsā with radical positions on the sound origin of the meaning of linguistic statements. gakāraukāravisarjanīyā iti bhagavān upavarṣaḥ 'g', 'au' and 'h' tells us the venerable Upavarșa: the meaning of the word cow [gauḥ] comes from the meaning of the phonemes it contains (in opposition to the notion of sphota).
upavas [upavas₁] v. [1] pr. (upavasati) pp. (upoșita) to stay, to remain | to fast, to abstain from food; to practice continence.
upavasatha |upavasatha| m. ved. ceremony of the fasting day (not. the eve of a soma sacrifice).
upavasathīya |īya| amnf upavasathīyā véd. regarding upavasatha.
upavah [upavah₁] v. [1] pr. (upavahati) pp. (upodha) to bring near, to bring; to procure.
upavāsa [act. upavas] m. soc. [vinaya] fasting, fasting festival; abstinence from sensual gratifications.
upavāsin [agt. upavas] amnf upavāsinī who practices fasting, abstinence.
upavidyā [upavidyā] f. inferior knowledge; profane science.
upavipāśam [upavipāśa] adv. geo. near the Vipāţ river.

upaviś [upaviś₁] v. [6] pr. (upaviśati) pp. (upaviṣṭa) pf. (sam) to come near, to sit beside | to set (sun); to cultivate (soil); to devote oneself to — ps. (upaviśyate) to be seated — ca. (upaviśyati) pp. (upaveśita) to make sit, to install. upaviśyatām adr. sit down (ps. imp. "let him sit here"). upaviśantu adr. please sit down. īdrśam audāryam yasya bhavati rājann
tenātropaveṣṭavyam [Vikramacarita] Your Majesty, (only) one who has such magnanimity can sit here.

upaviṣa [ upaviṣa ] n. narcotic, drug — f. upaviṣā bio. bot. Aconitum ferox, ferocious aconite, herbaceous buttercup with blue flowers; its root contains the alkaloid pseudaconitine, a violent poison.
upaviṣṭá [pp. upaviś] amnf upaviṣṭā seated.

úpavīta [pp. upavyā] amnf upavītā en touré | soc. girded with the brahmanical cord — n. act of girding this cord | soc. sacred cord of the dvija; formed of 6 strands of cotton for the brahmins, it is worn diagonally between the left shoulder and the right side; its knot contains Brahmā; cf. upanayana, anujāta, vītasūtra, nivīta.
upavṛt [upavṛt₁] v. [1] pr. r. (upavartate) pp. (upavrtta) pf. (sam) to approach; to fall to; to rest.
upaveda [upaveda] m. lit. science min neure, art; set of texts supplementing the Vedas; we list: medicine [Ayurveda], art
cherished [Dhanurveda], music [Gāndharvaveda], and the science of weapons [Sastraśāstra]; but also: architecture [Sthāpatyaveda], ar knowledge
tistics [Śilpaśāstra] and the science of government [Arthaśāstra].
upaveśá [act. upaviś] m. act of sitting down; act of setting to a task | myth. np. du rși Upaveśa.
upaveśana [act. upaviś] n. action of sitting down; peaceful waiting.
úpaveśi m. n.p. of ṛṣi Upaveśi.
upaveśita [pp. ca. upaviś] amnf upaveśitā that one made to sit down.
upavyā [upavyā] v. [4] pr. r. (upavyayate) pp. (upavīta) to gird the Brahmanical cord.
upavyākhyāna [upavyākhyāna] n. explanation, interpretation.
upavyāghra [upavyāghra] m. organic. zoo. leopard — f. upavyāghrī organic. female leopard.

upavyūha [upavyūha] m. phil. [pañcarātra] secondary manifestation or aspect of Vișnu; the Rūpamandana gives the list of these 24 aspects with their iconographic representation by the position of the 4 attributes cakra, śańkha, gadā and padma in the 4 hands of the divinity; The respective attributes of the lower right hand, upper right hand, lower left hand, and upper left hand, denoted C, S, G, and P, are given in order: Keśava PSCG, Nārāyaṇa SPGC, Mādhava GCSP, Govinda CGPS, Mokṣada GPSC, Madhusūdana CSPG, Trivikrama PGCS, Vāmana SCGP, Šrīdhara PCGS, Hṛṣīkeśa GCPS, Varada SPCG, Dāmodara PSGC, Samkarsana GSPC, Vāsudeva GSCP, Pradyumna CSGP, Ani ruddha CGSP, Purusottama CPSG, Adhoksaja PGSC, Narasimha CPGS, Acyuta GPCS, Upen dra SGCP, Janārdana PCSG, Hari SCPG, and Krsna SGPC.
upaśam [upaśam₁] v. [4] pr. (upaśāmyati) pp. (Upaśānta) to calm down, to become calm; to fade away.
upaśama |act. upaśam| m. act of calming down, moderation; tranquility; cessation, stoppage.
upaśamaprakarana [prakarana] n. bed. n.p. of the Upaśamaprakarana, 4th section of the Moksopāya.
upaśaradam [upaśarad] adv. towards the autumn season.
Upaśānta pp. upaśam amnf upaśāntā calmed, pacified — m. hist. np. of the philosopher bd. Upaśānta, author of the Abhidharmahrdaya₂.
upaśānti [act. upaśam] f. cessation; remission; tranquility.
upaśāntiprakaraṇa [prakaraṇa] n. bed. n.p. of the upaśāntiprakaraṇa, 5th section of the Mokṣopāya.
upaśāya [act. upaśī] ifc. m. turn to sleep with (iic.). tava rājopaśāyaḥ it's your turn to sleep with the king.
upaśikṣ [upaśikṣ] v. pr. (upaśikṣati) to subjugate; to appropriate — pr. r. (upaśikṣate) to strive to help, to offer one's services | to inquire about, to study — ca. (upaśikṣayati) to instruct.
upaśī [upaśī₁] v. [2] pr. r. (upaśete) to be stretched out along; to be lying with.
upaśunam [upaśvan₁] adv. near the dog.
upaśubh [upaśubh₁] v. [1] pr. r. (upaśobhate) pp. (upaśobhita) to shine, to gleam — ca. (śobhayati) to adorn, to decorate.
upaśaila [upaśaila] m. hill.
upaśobhita [pp. upaśubh] amnf upaśobhitā orné, décoratif (de (iic.)).
upaśru [upaśru] v. [5] pr. (upaśṛṇóti) pp. (upaśruta) to listen; to pay attention; to hear, to learn.
upaśruta [pp. upaśru] amnf upaśrutā listened; heard | promised, concluded.
upaśruti [act. upaśru] f. listening; whispered words; hearsay; rumor | prophecy of an oracle.
upaślesa [upaślesa] m. close contact; contiguity | embrace.
upasamhāra [act. upasamhr] m. END; conclusion, epilogue; colophon | summary | phil. [Mīmāṃsā] conclusion of a section of text; opp. upakrama. .1

upasaṃhāravijaya [vijaya] m. lit. np. of the Upasamhāravijaya "Victory of the Conclusion sion", a polemical text by Vijayīndra refuting the Upakramaparākrama of Appayya Dīkṣita. upakramaparākramam nirākrtyopasamhāravijayo 'sau prakāśyate lit. [Vijayīndra] The Upakrama parākrama having been refuted, this Upasamhāravijaya shines forth.
upasamhāraṇa [act. upasaṃhṛ] n. action of removing.
upasaṃhārya [pfp. [1] upasaṃhṛ] amnf upasaṃhāryā phil. [Vedānta] which must be eliminated in meditation (said not. of the qualities of brah man).

upasaṃhṛ [upasaṃhṛ] v. [1] pr. r. (upasamharate) pp. (upasamhrta) to bring into contact, to assemble | to withdraw, to refuse, to suppress, to annihilate; to absorb; to summarize, to interrupt, to approach oneself.
upasaṃhṛta [pp. upasaṃhṛ] amnf upasamhṛtā brought closer, put into contact | held back, withdrawn | interrupted; stopped; deleted; excluded; ab absorbed; destroyed.
upasamhṛti [act. upasamhṛ] f. assem
blage | conclusion, end | lit. [theatre] catastrophe; apotheosis; denouement; syn. nirvahana.
upasaṃgam var. upasaṅgam [upasaṃgam] v. [1] pr. r. (upasaṃgacchate) pp. (upasaṃgata) to approach, to join.
upasaṃgrah [upasaṃgrah] v. [9] pr. (upasaṃgṛḥṇāti) soc. to take someone's feet in one's hands as a sign of respect.
upasamgraha [act. upasamgrah] m. action of seizing or touching in a manner of supplication.

upasaṃgrahaṇa [act. upasaṃgrah] n. soc. gesture of homage (not. towards one's guru) where one touches one's ears with the hands which are then crossed and pressed on the feet of the person with the head bowed.
upasad₁ [upasad₁] v. [1] pr. (upasidati) pp. (upasanna) to sit on | to sit near, to approach respectfully; to seek instruction from a teacher; to revere — ca. (upasādayati) to place on or beside.
upasad₁ |agt. upasad₁| amnf who sits near, who approaches respectfully; who honors.
upasanna |pp. upasad₁| amnf upasannā placed on ; approached (for instruction, protection or worship).
upasamasta [upasamasta] m. gram. constituent of a compound.

upasaṃpad₁ [upasaṃpad₁] v. [4] pr. r. (upasampadyate) pp. (upasampanna) to obtain, succeed in; to attain | equal; to be equivalent to — ca. (upasampādayati) to bring near, to bring close to procure | bd. to give ordination, to receive as a monk.
upasampad₁ [act. upasampad₁] f. bd. or superior order, entry into the orders | var. upasampadā id.
upasaṃpadājñapti [ājñapti] f. bed. n.p. of the Upasampadājñapti, ordination manual bd.
upasampanna [pp. upasampad₁] amnf upasampannā bd. entered into orders.
upasara [act. upasr] m. approach | not. ap close to a female by a male; insemination (cow).
upasaraṇa [act. upasṛ] n. approach; act of getting closer | med. congestion | refuge.

upasarga [act. upasṛj] m. event; subjection; misfortune, evil, accident | gram. codenotative preposition; preverb; cf. pra, ā, vi, parā, apa, sam, anu, ava, nis, dus, ni, adhi, api, ati, ut, abhi, prati, pari, upa. kriyāviśeṣaka upasargaḥ gram. [Kātyāyana] The preverb determines the action.

upasarganipāta | nipāta | iic. gram. prepositions and particles. Upasarganipātadyotakatvavācakatvavicāra [dyotakatvavācakatvavicāra] m. gram. np. the Upasarganipātadyotakatvavācakatvavicāra from "Considerations relating to the expressive power of prepositions and particles" by Harikṛṣṇa Paṇḍita.
upasargamandana [mandana] n. gram. n.p. from the Upasargamandana, supplement to Vopadeva's Kavikalpa druma giving the meaning of roots provided with preverbs, due to Maṇḍana₁ Mantrī (1435).
upasargārtha [artha] m. gram. use of a preverb; we distinguish between the codenotative use [anuvartate], the privative use [bhādate], and the use
intensive [viśinasti].
upasargārthacandrikā [candrikā] f. gram. n.p. from the upasargārthacandrikā, work by Charu dev Shastri discussing the use of preverbs and prepositions.

upasarjana [act. upasrj] n. act of pouring on, of acting on; action, imposition; dependence, control, command | gram. secondary or subordinate component of a compound word; opp. pradhāna — amnf upasarjanā ifc. subordinate to, auxiliary of (iic.) — f. upasarjanī infusion.
upasartavya [pfp. [3] upasṛ] amnf upa sartavyā who must be approached for his protection to whom one must resort.
upasarpaṇa [act. upasṛp] n. act of approaching stealthily.
upasarpin [agt. upasrp] amnf upasarpinī who approaches stealthily.
upasāntvana [upasāntvana] n. act of appeasement or reconciliation; consolation of (g. iic.) | pl. upasāntvanāni good words.
upasikta [pp. upasic] amnf upasiktā sprinkled with, sprinkled with (i. iic.).
upasic [upasic] v. [6] pr. (upasiñcati) pp. (upasikta) pour over, sprinkle with.
Upasunda [upaSunda] m. myth. np. du dai tya Upasunda, who killed himself with his brother Sunda for the possession of Tilottamā.
upasṛ [upasṛ] v. [1] pr. (upasarati) pp. (upasrta) pf. (sat) approach.

upasṛj [upasṛj₁] v. [6] pr. (upasṛjati) pp. (upasṛṣṭa) release; spread over, water; emit bring closer; accompany, lead (a calf to its mother) | come into contact with, put in contact; add to | visit; afflict, fall upon; subject, submit, make suffer, control.
upasṛp [upasṛp] v. [1] pr. (upasarpati) pp. (upasṛpta) to creep towards, to approach creeping (acc.); to approach sexually; to spy | to start to (inf.) — ca. (upasarpayati) to make approach.
upasrpta [pp. upasrp] amnf upasrptā sexually possessed.

upasṛṣṭa [pp. upasṛj] amnf upasṛṣṭā issued; sent, led | not. (calf) led to its mother; (milk) sucked by the calf | provided with | gram. furnished with a preverb | visited by, afflicted with, burdened with, suffering from possessed by (god, demon) — n. coit.
upaseka [act. upasic] m. aspersion.
upasecana [obj. upasic] n. sauce (poured over a dish).
upasev [upasev] v. [1] pr. r. (upasevate) pp. (upasevita) to frequent, to practice | to be at the service of, to pay homage to.
upasevana [act. upasev] n. act of paying homage; service | act of courting (not. another man's wife) | use; addiction; act of enduring.
upasevā [act. upasev] f. act of honoring; fact of being devoted to; act of courting.
upasevin [agt. upasev] ifc. amnf upa sevinī which pays homage to (iic.).
upaskara |agt. upakr| m. utensil, accessory; ornament | ingredient, condiment, spice.
upaskr cf. upakr.
upaskṛta [pp. upakṛ] amnf upaskṛtā obtained by effort; altered; supplemented | arranged, elaborated; embellished, adorned, decorated | deformed, spoiled.
upastīrṇa [pp. upastṛ] amnf upastīrṇā littered with, lined with.
upastṛ [upastṛ] v. [9] pr. (upastṛṇāti) pp. (upastīrņa) to spread, scatter, cover with (i.).

upástha [agt. upasthā] m. [“that which is near”] middle part; protected place — mn sex; not. vagina, female genital organ | phil. [Sāmkhya] faculty [karmendriya] of reproduction, whose regent [niyantr] is Prajāpati; its predominant element [bhūta] is water; the associated perception [tanmātra] is flavor [rasa] which excites the sense [buddhīndriya] of taste [jihvā]. upastham kṛ to sit on one's heels. upasthe kr to take in one's lap.
upasthadaghna [daghna] amnf upasthadaghnā f. upasthadaghnī who has (water) up to her buttocks.

upasthā [upasthā₁] v. [1] pr. (upatiṣṭhati) pr. r. (upatiṣṭhate) pp. (upasthita) pf. (sam) to stand near; to approach, to pay homage to; to worship, to pray | to serve, to be under the orders of; to ally with | to fall to; to fall under the power of — ca. (upasthāpayati) to have placed near; to have one lie down near | to bring near, to procure; to fetch. ādityam upatisthate he worships the Sun. devadatto yajñadattam upatisthate Devadatta became friends with Yajñadatta. ayam panthā pāṭaliputram upatiṣṭhate this road leads to Pāṭaliputra. yāvadbhojanam upatiṣṭhate he is always ready when it comes to eating. sākṣī nopatasthau the witness did not appear. tvayopasthātavyam you will have to be there in person.
upasthāna [act. upasthā] n. act of approaching; act of serving, of paying homage.

upasthāp [ca. upasthā] v. [10] pr. (upasthāpayati) pp. (upasthāpita) to place near; to make lie down near | to bring near, to bring near, to procure; to go looking for | gram. add the particle iti after a word.
upasthāpaka [agt. ca. upasthā] am .3 nf upasthāpikā which draws attention (to an event of the past or of a previous life); which makes one remember.
upasthāpana [act. ca. upasthā] n. act of placing near — f. upasthāpanā act of remembering | jn. ordination of a monk.
upasthita [pp. upasthā] amnf upasthitā that approached; appeared, arrived | near, that will happen | received, obtained; due | visited — n. gram. (word) followed by iti.
upasthiti [act. upasthā] f. presence; proximity | accomplishment; attainment; completion citation; memory | gram. ["that which comes to mind"] meaning produced by an affix.
upasparśana [act. upaspṛś] n. ablution; bath.

upaspṛś [upaspṛś₁] v. [6] pr. (upaspṛśati) pr. r. (upasprśate) pp. (upasprṣṭa) to touch the top, to reach the height of | to caress | to touch (not. water to purify oneself); to bathe (religious rite); to drink water in the hollow of one's hands (to rinse one's mouth) | to touch a part of the body (acc.) with water (i.).
upahata |pp. upahan| amnf upahatā at tinged with, affected by, spoiled by | hindered, contested, contradicted. vetālopahata haunted by a ghost. kāmopahatacetana whose thoughts are filled with lust.
upahan [upahan₁] v. [2] pr. (upahanti) pp. (upahata) to strike, to hit; to prevent, to damage. ger. daṇḍopaghātaṃ gāḥ kālayati he gathers the cows by striking them with a stick.
upahavá [act. upahū] m. invitation. upahavam is wishing to be invited (to (loc.)).
upahas [upahas] v. [1] pr. (upahasati) pp. (upahasita) to mock, to mock, to ridicule — ca. (upahāsayati) to ridicule.
upahasita [pp. upahas] amnf upa hasitā mocked; ridiculed — act. n. burst of laughter, with movement of the shoulders and widening of the nostrils.
upahasta [upahasta] m. act of taking or receiving with the hand — v. [11] pr. (upahas tayati) to take with the hand, to receive.

upahāra [obj. upahṛ] m. offering, oblation (to a deity) | gift, present (to a superior) | alliance obtained by gift | food offered to guests | soc. [pāśupata] ritual orgy. upahāram vidhā to offer an oblation to a deity acc. .

upahāravarman [varman] m. lit. [DKC.] np. of Prince Upahāravarmā, one of the 10 heroes of the Daśakumāracarita; he is the son of King Prahāravarmā of Videha; lost in the jungle during an attack by Kirātās, he was taken in by a hermit; on the way to Mithilā, he found his nanny who helped him to kill the usurper Vikațavarmā, to pass himself off as him, and to marry his favorite Kalpasundarī.
upahāsá [act. upahas] m. mockery, affront; irony.
upahāsaka [agt. upahas] amnf upahāsikā who mocks, who makes fun of, who ridicules — m. joker — n. joke, mockery.
upahāsin [agt. upahas] ifc. amnf upahāsinī which turns into ridicule (iic.).
upahāsya [pfp. [1] upahas] amnf upahāsyā laughable; ridiculous.
upahāsyatā [tā] f. the state of being ridiculous. aham upahāsyatām gamisyāmi I will cover myself in ridicule. sarvajanasyopahāsyatāmupayānti they became the laughingstock of all.

upahita [pp. upadhā₁] amnf upa hitā placed on, deposited; placed in, near; ins talled, connected to | used to | brought, handed over, given | dependent on, having as a condition | gram. immediately preceded by (iic.).
upahu [upahu] v. [3] pr. (upajuhoti) pp. (apa huta) to offer a sacrifice, to pour into the fire; to add an oblation.
upahū [upahū] v. [1] pr. r. (upahvayate) pp. (upahūta) abs. (upahūya) to call near; in to invite | to encourage — pr. r. (upahvayate) to challenge.
upahūta [pp. upahū] amnf upahūtā ap pelé, invited; invoked.
upahṛ [upahṛ₁] v. [1] pr. (upaharati) pp. (upahṛta) to pull towards oneself; to offer — ca. (upahārayati) to present, to offer.
upahṛta [pp. upahṛ] amnf upahṛtā offered.
upāṃśu [upaaṃśu] adv. ["while waiting for the soma"] in a low voice | in secret — m. soc. whispered prayer (in the Vedic liturgy, before bringing the soma).
upāṃśudaṇḍa [daṇḍa] n. punishment inflicted in private.
upākaraṇa [act. upākṛ ] n. preparation, beginning | soc. start of reading the Veda. .4
upākarman [upākṛman] n. soc. beginning of Vedic studies; cf. utsarjana.
upākṛ [upaākṛ] v. [8] pr. (upākaroti) pp. (upākṛta) to give, to transmit; to procure, to obtain nir | to prepare (not. a sacred ceremony); between taking.
upākhyā | upaākhyā ₂| f. nickname.
upākhyāna [upaākhyāna] n. lit. short auxiliary narrative, episode; story inserted within a frame narrative.
upāgam [upaāgam] v. [1] pr. (upāgacchati) pp. (upāgata) pf. (sam) to approach, come towards | to return, come back | to be subject to; to fall due, to occur.
upāgama [act. upāgam] m. arrival; ap near; occurrence | agreement | lit. text āgama auxi liaire.
upāgni [upaagni] adv. on the fire; near the fire.
upāghrā [upaāghrā] v. [3] pr. (upājighrati) to sniff, smell | to give a kiss (to (loc.)).

upāṅga [upaaṅga₁] n. subdivision of the body subdivision; complement, annex; auxiliary part of a knowledge | lit. auxiliary literature of the Veda; not. mythological legends [purāṇa], law texts [dharmaśāstra], supplementary treatises [vedānga] [jn. class of Jain sacred texts.
upāje adv. in support. upājekṛtya var. upāje kṛtvā having helped.
upātī [ upaatī ] v. [2] pr. ( upātyeti ) to omit; to neglect; to transgress.
upātta |contr. upādatta| amnf upāttā resulting from.
upātyaya [act. upātī] m. transgression; non-conformity to customs.
upādā [upaādā] v. [3] pr. r. (upādadate) pp. (upātta) pfp. (upādeya) abs. (upādāya) to receive, accept; to seize, take.

upādāna [act. upādā ] n. act of appropriating; acquisition | bd. attachment, 9th cause of suffering [pratītyasamutpāda] | phil. [Nyāya] material cause (opp. nimitta, effective cause) | soc. the prelude to the gift, a pañcopāsana according to Rāmānuja.
upādānalakṣaṇā [lakṣaṇā] f. gram. rhet. figurative meaning "with inclusion".
upādānaśabda [śabda] m. gram. identified speech, combining signifier [dhvani] and signified [sphota].
upādānopādeya [upādeya] m. phil. [Nyāya] cause and effect.
upādānopādeyabhāva [bhāva] m. phil. [Nyāya] cause-and-effect relationship.
upādāya |abs. upādā| ind. having taken; having received — prep. including; thanks to (acc.).
upādeya [pfp. [1] upādā] amnf upādeyā which must be taken; necessary — n. phil. [Nyāya] the effect.
upādhā [upaādhā] v. [3] pr. (upādádhāti) pp. (upāhita) place on — pr. r. (upādhatté) seize; take; seduce (a woman).

upādhi [act. upādhā] m. substitute, substitution; condition, postulate; attribute; appellation; title | appearance, disguise; deception | phil. contingent condition of being; falsifiable hypothesis phil. [Nyāya] imposed or acquired property; limiting condition; particular qualification; opp. jāti.
upādhika [upaadhika] amnf upādhikā supernumerary, in excess.

upādhyāya [upaadhyāya] m. master, preceptor, spiritual director — ifc. scholar's title, forming proper names — f. upādhyāyā f. upādhyāyī wife of the master. upādhyāyāt purāṇaṃ śṛṇoti He listens to the purāṇa from the mouth of the master.
upānáh [upanah] f. [sg. name. upānat] san dale; shoe — m. var. upānaha id.
upānatka [ka] f. upānatkā ifc. who has (iic.) his shoes.
upānahin |in| amnf upānahinī who wears sandals.
upānī [upaānī] v. [1] pr. (upānayati) pp. (upānīta) to bring near; to bring closer; to introduce | to remove, to take away.
upāntá [upaanta] amnf upāntā near the end; penultimate — n. ["proximity to the limit"] neighborhood, edge.
upāntika [upaantika] n. neighbourhood, proximity — amnf upāntikā near, neighbour. upāntikam near, towards. upāntikāt of the neighbourhood.

upāya [act. upe₁] m. approach, effective means, method; attainment; expedient, stratagem, ruse; advantage | that by which one reaches the goal, way (not. of salvation) | advantage, score (cf. apāya) | soc. ritual averting an unfavorable occasion | bd. conventional truth; cf. samvrti | gram. rule of grammar | phil. stratagem to subjugate an adversary; there are 4: negotiation [sāman], the
corruption [dāna], betrayal [bheda] and attack
frontal [daṇḍa]; cf. bala | bd. [Tantra] designates the yogi in erotic bd symbolism. .5 upāyatas adv. by an expedient; by cunning.
upāyakauśalya [kauśalya] n. bd. [Mahāyāna] skillful means of teaching the doctrine.

upāyana [act. upe₁] n. approach; arrival soc. not. arrival as a student at the master's house; the act of undertaking an observance | soc. arrival gift to a guest. mālavikopāyanam presitā Mālavikā was sent as a present.
upār |upaṛ| pft. (upāra) to approach; to hasten towards | to make a mistake; to transgress.
upārá |act. upār | m. transgression; sin.
upāruh [upaāruh] v. [1] pr. (upārohati) to go up to, to ascend to | to reach, to attain — ca. (upāropayati) pp. (upārohita) to cause to reach.
upārj [upaṛj] v. [1] pr. (upārjati) pp. (upārjita) pf. (sam) ca. (upārjayati) procure; acquire, obtain, gain.
upārjita [pp. upārj] amnf upārjitā ob tenu, gagné.
upālabh [upaālabh] v. [1] pr. r. (upālabhate) pp. (upālabdha) to reprimand, to blame.
upālambha [act. upālabh] m. reproach, blame, reprimand.
upālambhana |act. upālabh| n. reproach; censure.
Upāli m. bd. n.p. of Upāli, Buddha's principal disciple; he recited the monastic rules [vinaya] at the first bd council. of Rājagaha, 3 months after his parinirvāṇa.
upās [upaas₁] pf. (sam) v. [5] pr. r. (upāśnute) pp. (upāṣṭa) to reach, to arrive at, by coming to (acc.); to obtain, to acquire.
upāśraya [obj. upāśri ] m. support, cushion | soc. meditation strap, used to hold the legs in yoga postures; cf. yogapattaka.
upāśri [upaāśri] v. [1] pr. (upāśrayati) pp. (upāśrita) pf. (sam) to rely on, to depend on, to seek refuge in, to abandon oneself to.
upāśrita [pp. upāśri] amnf upāśritā who relies on, who has recourse to, who takes refuge in acc. .

upās [upaās₂] v. [2] pr. r. (upāste) pp. (upāsita) pf. (pari) to sit beside; to pay homage to, honor, serve, devote oneself to | to be awaiting (not. instructions); to expect | to submit to; to endure, suffer | to approach, enter into the state of; to consider, know, understand. andham tamah praviśanti ye 'sambhūtim upāsate [IU.] Those who worship the Unmanifest enter into the darkness of darkness. andham tamah praviśanti ye 'vidyām upāsate | tato bhūya iva te tamo ya u vidyāyām ratāḥ | [BU.] They enter into darkness blindly, those who follow doctrines of ignorance, and into even thicker darkness those who cling to knowledge.
upāsaka [agt. upās] amnf upāsikā ser viteur | adept; faithful, disciple | occupied with; intending to | bd. lay disciple of the Buddha; opp. bhikşu.
upāsakadaśā [daśā] f. pl. lit. 7th text of the Jaina canon, biography of lay disciples.

upāsana [act. upās ] n. homage, respect; submission to; adoration, devotion, service | soc. rite of adoration of a divinity, not. of his istadevatā; Rāmānuja codified it in 5 stages [pañcopāsana] — ifc. knowledge of (iic.); adoration of (iic.) — f. upāsanā id.
upāsita [pp. upās] amnf upāsitā served, honored, worshipped | (active) who served, who worshipped (acc.). śivamupāsitah he served Šiva.
upāsitavya [pfp. [3] upās] amnf upāsitavyā which must be honored or revered.
upāsīna [upaāsīna] amnf upāsīnā as sis near ; attentive to, to the orders of | the one near whom one is going to sit.

upāsya [pfp. [1] upās] amnf upāsyā res pectable, to be honored; venerable, that which must be adored, that which is the object of worship | that which must be approached; that which must be served; that which must be endured | to be known, to know — abs. ind. having honored, having paid homage to.
upe₁ [upai] v. [2] pr. (upaiti) pp. (upeta) abs. (upetya) pf. (abhi, sam) to approach, go towards; to meet, approach sexually | to begin, undertake; to perform (rite); to dedicate oneself to.
upe₁ [upae] v. [2] pr. (upaiti) pp. (upeta) abs. (upetya) pf. (abhi) approach, come towards; approach sexually.
upekṣ [upaīkṣ] v. [1] pr. r. (upekṣate) pp. (upeksita) to neglect, to leave unfinished | to perceive; to support, to suffer; to take into account, to supervise; to agree.
upekṣaṇa [act. upekṣ] n. carelessness, negligence; indifference. .6
upekṣā [act. upekṣ] f. negligence; indifference | evenness of temper, serenity | phil. equanimity, one of the four moral qualities |brahmavihāra| | pali upekkhā.

upeta [pp. upe₁] amnf upetā approached; served by, accompanied by, provided with (i.); entered into such a state — ifc. furnished with, provided with, endowed with, possessing (iic.). sarvasvāmiguņopeta endowed with all princely qualities. parihāsacaturaiḥ suhṛdbhirupetaḥ [K.] In the company of his friends gifted in games of wit.
upetya₁ [pfp. [1] upe₁] amnf upetyā to undertake.
upetya₁ [abs. upe₁] ind. having approached; having reached — prep. concerning.

Upendra [upaIndra] m. myth. np. of Upendra "Younger son of Indra", epithet of Vishnu as the lastborn of Aditi, a title bestowed by Indra upon Krishna; he is represented as a child [bālarūpin]; also epithet of Vishnu as the dwarf Brahmin Vāmana. upendravajrā phon. homosyllabic epic meter of 4 feet of 11 syllables [tristubh], of jata jagaga pattern, with a pause after the 5th and 11th syllables; it is distinguished from indravajrā by its 1st syllable, which is short.
upeya [upe₁ya] amnf upeyā which must be approached or undertaken; syn. upetya₁ | to be attained; goal.
upoḍha [pp. upavah] amnf upoḍhā near; next; advanced, brought — iic. that goes — f. upoḍhā second wife.
upodhatapas [tapas] amnf who is about to perform penances.
upottama [upauttama] amnf upottamā gram. penultimate (syllable). upottamam gram. (with the stress) on the penultimate syllable.
upodakī [upaudaka] f. organic. bot. Basella alba, Malabar spinach.
upodghāta [act. upoddhan] m. introduction, preface; beginning; exposition, prerequisite | lit. intercalary narrative episode | lit. example, illustration; rhet. tool of exegesis.
upoddhan [upauddhan] ca. (upodghātayati) to speak first, to introduce, to begin.
upoṣ [upauṣ] v. [1] pr. (upoṣati) to burn.
upoșana [act. upavas] n. young.

upoșita [pp. upavas] amnf upoșitā who fasts, who has fasted — n. fast. papau nimesālasapaksmapanktir tam upositābhyām iva locanābhyām [Ragh.] She, who had a row of eyelashes tired of blinking, the purpose of her eyes, as if they had fasted for a long time. ਤਸ upta₁ [pp. vap₁] amnf uptā shaved. ਤਸ upta₂ [pp. vap₂] amnf uptā sown, scattered.
uptágādha [gādha] amnf uptagādaha sown densely. ਤਮ੍ ubh cf. umbh. ਤਮ ubhá [umbh] pn. mnf ubhā du. the two, both || gr. ; lat. ambo; fr. ambigu. āvāmubhau we two.
ubhayátra [yatra] adv. on both sides, in both places | in both cases, both at the same time.
ubháya [ubhaya] amnf ubhayī one and the other, the two; of the two kinds | phil. the two worlds; Heaven and Earth.
ubháyakāma [kāma] amnf ubhayakāmā who desires both.
ubhayacakravartin | cakravartin | m. sovereign of the two worlds.
ubhayatva |tva| n. state of being double; said not. of the vowel 'u' in the pranava om.
ubhayáthā [thā] adv. in both ways.
ubhayapada [pada] amnf ubhayapadā gram. (said of a verb) conjugating both in the active voice [parasmaipada] and in the reflexive voice |ātmanepada|.
ubháyapadin |in| amnf ubhayapadinī gram. vb. se conconjuga à deux en parasmaipada et en ātmanepada.
ubhayapadārtha | padārtha | amnf ubhaya padārthā gram. analytical; said of a compound whose meaning composes that of its two members (not. dvandva).
ubhayapārśvatas [pārśvatas] adv. on both sides.
ubhayabhāga [bhāga] amnf ubhayabhāgā which participates in both; not. diurnal and nocturnal.
ubhayabhāgahara [bhāgahara] amnf ub hayabhāgaharā usable in two ways | med. said not. of a potion that is both a purge and an emetic.
ubhayavyañjana [vyañjana] n. hermaphrodite.
ubhayaślesa [ślesa] m. bed. ambiguity of a text combining sabhangaślesa and abhangaślesa.
ubhayābhāva [abhāva] m. phil. [nyaya] mutual absence, incompatibility.
ubhayābhisārikā [abhisārikā] f. lit. np. from the Ub hayābhisārikā, a satirical comedy by Vararuci₁. .7
ubhayátas [adv. ubhaya] adv. on both sides, in both cases, both at the same time; on both sides of acc. g. — iic. equipped with two ifc. .
ubhayátaḥkālam [kāla₁] adv. twice; in two parts.
ubhayátahprajña [prajñā₂] amfn ubhayatahprajñā phil. whose knowledge is turned both inwards and outwards.
ubhayataḥsasya | sasya | amnf ubhayataḥsasyā which produces two harvests per year. ਤਮਧਾ ubhayā [ubhaya] adv. in two ways.
ubhaye [loc. ubhaya] ind. in either one.
ubhayedyús [dyu] adv. the two days.
úmā f. myth. n.p. of Umā "Light", epith. of DurgāPārvatī, wife of ŚivaMaheśvara | organic. bot. Linum usitatissimum, flax.

Umāpati₁ [pati] m. myth. np. of Umāpati₁, epith. of Siva "husband of Umā" | hist. np. of the Tamil poet Umāpati₁ Šivācārya (Tamil Nadu, 12th century); he is the author of the devotional poem Kuñcitānghristava; his āśrama is the presumed place where Siva granted the weapon Pāśupata to Arjuna as a reward for his penances.
umāpatidhara [dhara] m. hist. n.p. of the poet Umāpatidhara, minister of King Vijayasena (12th century); he is the author of the Deopara inscription, which praises [praśasti] the Sena dynasty.
umāmaheśvara [Maheśvara] m. myth. iconographic representation of Umā entwined with Maheśvara, symbolizing the dissolution of duality arising from ignorance.
umāmaheśvarasaṃvāda [saṃvāda] m. lit. np. of the Uumāmaheśvarasaṃvāda "Dialogue between Umā and Maheśvara", episode of the Mah.
Umāsamhitā [samhitā] f. bed. n.p. from the Umāsamhitā, section of the Šivapurāṇa; cf. Pañcacūḍā.
umāsahāya [sahāya] m. myth. np. of umāsahāya, epith. of Shiva "Companion of Umā".
Umāsuta [suta₂] m. myth. np. of Umāsuta, epith. of skanda "son of Umā".
umāskanda [skanda] m. arch. np. of umāskanda, epith. of Śiva "accompanied by Umā and skanda"; it is one of the 16 aspects of Shiva; syn. somaskanda.
umāskandasahita [sahita₂] m. id.
umāsvāmin [svāmin] m. hist. np. of the master [ācārya] jn. Umāsvāmī; he lived around the 2nd century; he is credited with the foundation of Jain doctrine in the Tattvārthasūtra.
Umeśa |īśa| m. myth. np. of Umeśa, epith. of Shiva "Lord of Umā" | image representing Umā and Śiva together.
√ umbh v. [9] pr. (ubhnāti) v. [6] pr. (umbháti) pp. (ubdhá) pf. (apa) unite; couple | cover; confine.
Ura iic. uras.
urága [ga₁] m. serpent ["that crawls"] | myth. dra gon or serpent spirit [nāga]; not. np. of Uraga "that goes on the chest (of Shiva)", the roidragon Ura garāja.
uragāsya |āsya| n. spade "in the shape of a snake's head".
Ura forms various primary nouns.
úraṇa [related to ūrṇa ] m. bio. sheep; ram. Uraņaka |ka| m. id.
uraṇakavatsa [vatsa] m. lamb. ਤਦਮ urabhra [related to uraṇa] m. bio. sheep; ram.
uraś iic. uras.
uraśchada | chada | mr. armor.
úras [r] n. chest — ifc. var. urasa which is at the head of (iic.) — v. [11] pr. (urasyati) to become strong. aśvorasam the best of horses.
uraska |ka| ifc. amnf uraskā at the chest (iic.).
urasya |ya| amnf urasyā concerning the breast; pectoral; coming from the breast | requiring the use of the breast | legitimate (son | "from his own breast"]); syn. aurasa — m. breast.
urasi [loc. uras] iic. urasikr consent. urasikṛtya japen mantram that he murmurs the prayer of his own free will.
urasiloma |loman| amn with a hairy chest.
urī cf. ūrī.

urú [vṛ₁] amnf urvī large, great; extensive, spacious; excessive; excellent — n. Space, extent — adv. far, far away; widely — f. urvī land; path. urum kr to make room for; to give an opportunity to; to relieve. urum vrt to circumscribe, to include.
Urukrama [krama] m. myth. np. of Urukrama, epith. of VișnuTrivikrama "who strides over Space".
Urugāya | gāya | m. myth. np. of Urugāya, epith. of VisnuTrivikrama "who travels through Space".
