pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara [prakṛtisvara] m. gram. (maintenance of the) original tone of the front member of a compound.
pūrvapadārtha [artha] m. gram. meaning of the anterior member of a compound.
pūrvapadārthapradhāna [pradhāna] amn gram. is said of a compound whose main meaning is that of the anterior member; cf. avyayībhāva.
pūrvaparvata [parvata] m. geo. mountain of the East (from which the Sun rises).
pūrvapaścāt [paścāt] adv. from East to West.
pūrvapīṭhikā [pīṭhikā] f. bed. introduction to a work | mod. preview presentation.

pūrvaprosthapadā [prosthapadā] f. pl. astr. np. of Pūrvaprosthapadās "the front feet of the bed", 24th lunar asterism [nakṣatra], corr. to the stars alpha beta of Pegasus; Ajaikapād presides over it; its symbol is a resting bed; later also called Pūrvabhādrapadās.
pūrvaphalgunī [phalgunī] f. astr. of np. pūrvaphalgunī "the first Reddish", 9th lunar asterism [nakṣatra], corr. to the star Delta Leo (Zosma); Bhaga presides over it.
pūrvabhāga [bhāga] m. lit. np. of the pūrvabhāga, first part of the Kādambarī, due to Bāṇa₂.
pūrvabhādrapadā [bhādrapadā] f. pl. astr. n.p. from Pūrvabhādrapadās “the auspicious Front Feet (of the bed)”; cf. Pūrvaprosthapadās.

pūrvamīmāmsā [Mīmāmsā] f. phil. the original Mīmāmsā, philosophy attributed to Jaimini, one of the 6 points of view [saddarśana] of orthodox Hinduism; it is the hermeneutics, or exegesis of the Veda and not. of the Vedic ritual; it experiences through the rite the link between man and the supernatural; cf. Sabara₁, Prabhākara.
pūrvamīmāṃsāśāstra [śāstra] n. phil. n.p. from the pūrvamīmāmsāśāstra, attributed to Jaimini; cf. pūrvamīmāmsāsūtra.
pūrvamīmāṃsāsūtra [sūtra] n. bed. n.p. from the pūrvamīmāmsāsūtra, or Mīmāmsāsūtra of Jai mini; it includes the Dvādaśalakṣaṇī and the Samkarşakānda.

pūrvaranga [ranga] m. soc. [Nāṭyaśāstra] preliminary rites of a play; after a musical piece, the theater director [sūtradhāra] enters the stage with two assistants carrying the jarjara and the bhṛṅgāra; after a purification with the water of the bhṛṅgāra, he raises the jarjara as the banner of Indra [indradhvaja], he pronounces his
blessing [nandī], then lowers the jarjara; follows a burlesque farce [trigata] with the vidūṣaka, then the praise of the plot [prarocanā]; then the play proper begins with its prologue |prastāvanā|.
pūrvarātra |rātra| m. first half of the night.

pūrvavat [vat] amnf pūrvavatī relating to what precedes; which concerns an antecedent — m. phil. [Nyāya] conclusion of a previous cause — n. phil. [Nyāya] reasoning inferring a cause from an effect; opp. śeṣavat — f. pūrvavatī previously married woman — adv. pūrvavát as before; in consequence of what precedes; as previously stated.
pūrvavayas [vayas₁] amnf ["at the beginning of life"] young.
pūrvavayasin |in| amnf pūrvavayasinī young.
pūrvavayaska |ka| amnf pūrvavayaskā id.
pūrvavayasa [vayasa₁] n. youth.
pūrvavarṣa [varṣa] m. last year.
pūrvavarṣās [varṣās] adv. before the rains.
pūrvavārṣika [ika] amnf pūrvavārṣikā specific to the period before the rains.
pūrvavipratisedha [vipratisedha] m. gram. conflict between two grammar rules giving priority to the earlier rule, contrary to the usual principle paravipratiședha.
pūrvavṛtta [vṛtta] amnf pūrvavṛttā which precedes in time, earlier.
pūrvavrtti [vrtti] f. anteriority.
pūrvaśikha [śikhā] amnf pūrvaśikhā soc. who wears the reserved lock in front; opp. aparasikha.

pūrvasara [sara] amnf pūrvasarī who walks first. pūrvasavarņasandhi [savarņasandhi] m. phon. type of sandhi where the consonant "h" at the beginning of a word assimilates to the aspirated final consonant of the preceding word, as in taddhitam. .1
pūrvasāra |sāra| amnf pūrvasārī which goes towards the East.
pūrvasūtra |sūtra| amnf pūrvasūtrā gram. [Kātyāyana] refers to grammars prior to Pāṇini.
pūrvahāyana |hāyana| amnf pūrvahāyanā of the previous year.
pūrvācārya |ācārya| m. gram. grammarian prior to Pāṇini.
pūrvāmnāya [āmnāya] m. phil. "Eastern doctrine", order of Sankara₁ whose matha is located in Purī.
pūrvārdhá | ardha | mn frontal part; anterior part (opp. uttarārdha) | East side.
pūrvārdhya [ya] amnf pūrvārdhyā on the eastern side.

pūrvāṣāḍhā [aṣāḍhā] f. pl. astr. np. of Pūrvāṣāḍhās "the Former Invincibles", 18th lunar asterism [nakṣatra], corresponding to the star Delta in Sagittarius; Apa presides over it; its symbol is an elephant's tooth. pūrvāhņa |ahna| m. morning. sahapūrvāhņam adv. in the morning. pūrvāhņo deva | aparāhņaḥ pitaraḥ | | [SB.] In the morning, God is invoked, in the evening the shades. pūrvāhņakṛta [kṛta] amnf pūrvāhņakṛtā done in the morning. pūrvāhņatara |tara| amnf pūrvāhņatarā my late morning. pūrvāhņatare late without the morning.
pūrvopasthiti [upasthiti] f. gram. citation en primer (de la cause de l'application d'une règle).
pūrvaka [pūrvaka] amnf pūrvikā previous, earlier, first — ifc. preceded by, accompanied by (iic.).
pūrvakatva [tva] n. state of being prior.

pūrvam [acc. pūrva] adv. previously; before (abl.); first; formerly, in the past — ifc. beginning with, after (iic.); with, according to | pali pubba. adya pūrvam adv. until now. abodha pūrvam adv. unconsciously. aśruta pūrvam adv. not already heard.
pūrvāhņe [loc. pūrvāhņa] adv. in the morning. pūrvāhņetána [ana] amnf pūrvāhņetanī rela tif to the morning. pūrvāhņetarām |tarām| adv. late in the morning.
pūrvin [pūrvain] ifc. amnf pūrviņī who did (iic.) previously.
pūrve [loc. pūrva] iic.
pūrvedyus [dyu] adv. the day before, the day before. पृ व्च pūrvva gem. purva.
pūla mf pūlī bundle, sheaf, bouquet | pl. pūlās straw — v. [11] pr. (pūlayati) v. [1] pr. (pūlati) to collect, gather.

pūṣan |puṣ₁| m. myth. ved. np. of the radiant [āditya] Pūṣā "the Nourisher", patron of the trou peaus; personifying the nourishing Sun, he brings abundance; he is Idaspati, the master of libations; as master of the roads, he protects the traveler; he guards the gates and leads the bride to the groom; he repels the thief and finds the lost cattle; with his golden goad he can awaken Brahmā; Shiva having broken his teeth during the sacrifice of Dakṣa, he feeds on barley gruel [karambha]; his chariot is drawn by goats; astr. he presides over the nakṣatra Revatī (of the Fishes). devasya tvā savituh prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyām pūṣṇo hastābhyāmādade I receive with the hands of Pūṣā and the arms of the Aśvinau at the pressing of the di vin Savitā.

√ pr₁ v. [3] pr. (píparti) v. [9] pr. (pṛṇāti) to save, to rescue; to escort; to bring to (acc.); to deliver from (abl.); to protect | to be able to (inf.) | to surpass; to cross — ca. (pāráyati) to cause to cross; to rescue, to protect | to resist, to contend with; to overcome, to prevail over | gr. περαω; lat. experior; all. fah ren; ang. fare. yāvadaham priye As long as I live.

√ pr v. [9] pr. (prnāti) v. [3] pr. (piparti) aor. [5] (apārīt) pp. (pūrņá, pūrta) inf. (pūritum) pf. (abhi, ā, sam) to fill, to satisfy, to complete; to blow into (not. conch); to stretch (bow) — ca. (pārayati) pp. (pārita) to fill, to fulfill (a vow) — ca. (pūrayati) ca. r. (pupūrṣati) to desire to fill — ps. (pāryate) ps. (pūryate) to be filled, to be filled (with (i.)); be satisfied | lat. plenus, impleo; eng. full; all. voll; fr. full. jalam pūryate the water is filling. sá yá etám evám upāste pūryáte prajáyā paśúbhih [SB.] Whoever honors him thus will be showered with offspring and flocks.
√ ¬ pr₂ v. [5] pr. (pṛṇoti) pp. (pṛta) ps. (priyate) pf. (ā) |usual without pf.|.
pṛkta [pp. pṛc] amnf pṛktā mixed with; put in contact with (i. iic.).

√ pṛc v. [7] pr. (pṛṇákti) pr. r. (pṛṅkte) aor. [5] (aparcīt) pp. (pṛkta) pf. (upa, sam) to mix, to blend; to unite with (i. loc.) || gr. πλεκω; lat. plecto; all. flechten. পু ল্ডাক prechaka |agt. praś| amnf prechikā who asks, who inquires about g.; questioner — m. investigator; inquisitor | soc. examiner at an avadhāna session.
pṛccham [abs. praś] ind. having asked. পু ল্ড া prcchā [act. praś] f. question, request — ifc. question concerning (iic.).
prechya [pfp. [1] praś] amnf prechyā to ask; about which one must inquire. पृ छ pṛch cf. praś.
pṛṇá [imp. pṛ] ind. ved. filled!
prt f. [pl. loc. prtsú] battle.
pṛtanā |anā| f. battle | army.

√ prth [related to prath] v. [10] pr. (parthayati) to extend. ਸੁੱਖ pṛtha |agt. pṛth| amnf Pṛthā Large — m. palm of the hand | span (measurement of length, from the tip of the middle finger to the wrist, equal to 13 inches [angula], about 25 cm) — f. Pṛthā myth. [Mah.] np. of Pṛthā "the Large", daughter of the yādava prince Sūra, Who gave her as an adopted daughter to his neck sin Kunti, from which her other name of Kuntī; the sage Durvāsā gave her an incantation | mantra | by which she could be impregnated by a god; she tried the charm by invoking Sūrya, Who gave her his son Karna, and restored her virginity; Later, as the first wife of King Pāṇḍu, who could not procreate without dying, she gave birth to Yudhisthira with Dharma, to Bhīma with Vāyu, and to Arjuna with Indra.

pṛthak |pṛth| adv. separately, differently, distinctly (from (abl. i.)); apart; particularly | individually, one by one; for each. prthak prthak one by one. pṛthak candreṇa var. pṛthak candrāt moonless. pṛthak sarvam padaṃ sākāṅkṣam gram. |Vākyakāṇḍa| Each word being endowed with a mutual dependency. prthakat adv. id.
prthaktva [tva] n. singularity, particularity, indi
duality | phil. |Vaisesika| the property |guṇa| of individuality. pṛthaktvena adv. one by one, individually.
pṛthaggrīva [grīvā] amnf pṛthaggrīvā without neck.
prthagjana | jana | m. Common man, ordinary person; Man of low birth, boor | pl. pṛthagjanās the plebeians, the multitude.
pṛthagvidha [vidhā₂] amnf pṛthagvidhā of various kinds; multiple; varied | distinct from (abl.).

pṛthivī [f. Pṛthu₁] f. soil, earth | phil. the earth, one of the 9 substances [dravya₁] of the Vaiseka, one of the 5 elements [bhūta] of the Samkhya; its pañcabhūtasthala is Ekāmreśvara | myth. np. of pṛthivī "the immense", the earth personified; she is the wife of Dyau [Rgveda] or of Pṛthu₁ [purāṇa]. prthivīm gam to prostrate oneself.
prthivīdevī [devī] f. lit. [KSS.] np. of the vidyādharī queen Pṛthivīdevī, mother of Vegavatī and Mānasavega; she intervened against her son in favour of Naravāhanadatta.
prthivīpati [pati] m. ["master of the earth"] king. na aviṣṇuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ He who is not Viṣṇu cannot be king.

pṛthivīpāla [pāla] m. ["guardian of the earth"] king. ਸੁਖ਼ੂ pṛthú [pṛthu] amnf Pṛthvī Large, vast, extended, ample, immense — m. myth. np. of the good king Pṛthu₁ "the immense", a minor incarnation of Viṣṇu, created by churning the good part of Vena; a divine bow fell from the heavens at his birth; he leveled the earth to allow agriculture; he drew the Vachatre Sabalā of its riches in the golden age [satyayuga]; he is the primordial Man of the pre-Manu era, and the creator of royal investiture; Antardhāna and Vādī are his sons | myth. |Rām. | np. of king Pṛthu₁, son of Anaranya₁ father of Triśanku — f. cf. pṛthivī — f. cf. Pṛthvī || gr. πλατυς; lat. planus; fr. flat, plain.
pṛthula |la| amnf pṛthulā Large; big.
prthulāśva [aśva] m. myth. [Mah.] np. of the king pṛthulāśva "of the great horse", son of Anenā of the solar lineage [sūryavaṃśa]; he is father of Prasena jit.

Pṛthūdaka [udaka] n. geo. ["Large expanse of water"] np. of a place of pilgrimage on the North bank of the Sarasvatī — m. hist. np. of the mathematician Pṛthūdaka Svāmī (9th century); he commented on the Brāhmaguptasphuṭasiddhānta. পুথুক prthuka m. boy; young animal — n. rice ground in a mortar — f. pṛthukā girl.
Pṛthvī [f. Pṛthu₁] f. myth. np. of Pṛthvī the earth; cf. pṛthivī.
Pṛthvīdhāra |dhāra₁| m. myth. np. of Pṛthvīdhāra, epith. of Varāha "He who carries the earth"; cf. vāstupurusa.
pṛthvībhāranāśa [bhāranāśa] m. epith. of Kṛṣṇa "Who takes away the burden of the earth".

pṛthvīrāja [rāja] m. hist. np. of Pṛthvirāja III, last rājput king of the cāhuvāṇa dynasty; se lon le Prthvirājarasa, he married the daughter of the king of Kanyākubja by abducting her during a svayamvara to which he was not invited.
prthvīrājarasa | rasa| m. lit. du np. Prthvirājarasa, epic poem in brajabhāṣā by the bard Canda Bardai, in praise of King Prthvirāja III.
pṛthvīrūpa [rūpa] m. lit. [KSS.] np. of King Pṛthvīrūpa of Pratiṣṭhāna; he was very handsome, and married the beautiful Rūpalatā. .3
prdāku m. snake | tiger; panther; leopard || gr. o .
pṛśana |act. spṛś₁| n. attachment to — f. pṛśanī ved. tender, sweet.

Pṛśni [related to pṛṣat] varied, spotted, variegated (not. cows, snakes, frogs, etc.) | pl. multiple | myth. np. of a family of sages |rs| | myth. cf. Pṛṣṇi — f. spotted cow; (figuratively) the Earth, the starry or cloudy Sky.
pṛśniparṇī | parṇī | f. bio. bot. Desmodium gange ticum, shrub of the family Papilionaceae, with white or lilac flowers; it is one of the 5 minor medicinal roots [hrasvapañcamūla].
√ prs [related to sprs₁] v. [1] pr. (parsati) to sprinkle, to annoy; to vex.
pṛṣa iic. pṛṣat.
Prṣadhra | dhra | mr. myth. | Mah. | n.p. of Pṛṣadhra, a son of Manu.

pṛṣat [pṛṣat] amnf pṛṣatī spotted; variegated spotted animal; not. antelope; syn. pṛṣata | myth. said of animals ridden by the winds [marutas] | pl. pṛṣantas drops of water; rain; sprinkling. pṛṣatām pati m. |"master of the rain" | wind.
prsadaśva [aśva] amnf prsadaśvā antelope | myth. | "One who rides an antelope" | said of
winds | marutas |.
prsodara | udara | amnf prsodarā to the stomach
spotted | gram. | generic | refers to compounds whose formation is irregular (like prodara, which makes the elision of the 't').

pṛṣatá |pṛṣata| amnf pṛṣatī spotted, mottled — m. bio. zoo. axis axis, mottled deer (chital) | drop of water | myth. |Mah.| np. of pṛṣata “(with a mottled face)”, king of the Pañcālās; he was the friend of Bharadvāja; he is father of Drupada.
pṛṣanti [pṛṣat] m. drop of water.

(vi) to draw forward, pull forward; to put forward | to stretch, extend. সক্ষ prakṛṣṭa [pp. prakṛṣ] amnf prakṛṣṭā stretched; prolonged (not. time) | excellent, superior. prakrste long-term.

prakriyākaumudī [kaumudī] f. lit. np. of the prakriyākaumudī "Light on grammatical analysis", commentary on the Aşţādhyāyī due to Rāmacandra₂ (15th century); cf. Prakāśa.

prakriyāsarvasva [sarvasva] n. lit. np. from the Pra kriyāsarvasva "Encyclopedia of Derivation", a compendium on Sanskrit grammar by Nārāyaṇa₃ Bhaṭṭa of Melputtūr, Kerala (17th century). সক্রয় prakruś [Prakruś] v. [1] pr. (prakrośati) pp. (prakrusta) to shout, to call out, to yell at someone. (acc.). সঞ্জল্ prakṣal [Prakṣal] v. [10] pr. (prakṣālayati) to wash, to clean, to rinse. hastau prakṣālaya wash your hands.
prakṣālaka |agt. prakṣal| amnf prakṣālikā which washes.

prakṣālana [agt. prakṣal] amnf prakṣālanī who performs frequent ablutions — act. n. washing, purification; ablutions | cleaning product; filter; washing water. prakṣālanāddhi paṃkasya dūrādasparśanaṃ varam "better not to defile oneself than to perform lengthy ablutions"] prevention is better than cure.

prakṣip [Prakṣip] v. [6] pr. (prakṣipati) pp. (praksipta) to throw, to launch; to unspool | to drop, to lower | to add, to insert; to interpolate — ca. (prakṣepayati) to cause to be thrown; to cause to be put in (loc.). agnau praksipati ghrtam he drops the butter into the fire.

prakṣī [Prakṣī] v. [9] pr. (prakṣiṇāti) pp. (prakṣīṇa) destroy; use up, exhaust — ps. (prakṣīyate) perish; be exhausted.
prakṣepa [act. prakṣip] m. throw, jet, projection | med. addition of an ingredient in a preparation; increase of a dose | lit. insertion tion, interpolation.

prakhyā [Prakhyā] v. [2] pr. (prakhyāti) pp. (prakhyāta) see — ps. (prakhyāyate) be known, be visible, be famous — ca. (prakhyāpayati) make known, publish, announce.

pragalbhatā [tā] f. resolution, confidence, strength; boldness, insolence.
pragalbhita [pp. pragalbh] amnf pra galbhitā proud, arrogant | prominent.
pragā [pragā₂] v. [1] pr. (pragāyati) pp. (pragīta) to start singing; to celebrate by singing.
pragīta [pp. pragā] amnf pragītā recited while singing; sung | who started to sing — n. song.

praguṇa [praguṇa] amnf praguṇā correct, exact | in good condition; excellent. pragunīkṛ to arrange, put back in order; smooth. praguṇībhū to prepare for, to arrange for dat. . lunthanāya kāvyārthacaurāh pragunībhavanti [Bilhana] Plagiarists rearrange poetry to plunder it.
praguņita [praguņaita] amnf praguņitā corrected, arranged, smoothed.

pragrhya [pfp. [1] pragrah] amnf pragrhyā to be held separately | gram. [Aṣṭādhyāyī] invariable by exception to the sandhi, to be pronounced separately with hiatus; e.g. compound word with u, or final vowel not subject to the sandhi (endings ī, ū and e of the noun. acc. dual) — abs. ind. having taken, having seized; with (acc.).

pragraha [act. pragrah] m. act of seizing; mastery | astr. beginning of an eclipse | rein; rope;
lace | leader | dressage (horse).

praghāsín [in] amnf praghāsinī voracious.

pracaks [pracaks] v. [2] pr. r. (pracaste) to tell, announce, say, declare; to hold for, consider as (acc.); to call, name.
pracanda [pracanda] amnf pracandā very violent, furious, terrible; ferocious — m. myth. np. of pracanda "terrible", one of the two guardians [dvārapālau] of Shiva; his companion is Caṇḍa.
Pracaṇḍacaṇḍikā [caṇḍikā] f. myth. n.p. of Pracandacandikā or Pracandogracandikā, epith. from Candikā “the fierce”.

pracandavarman [varman] m. bed. [DKC.] np. of Pracandavarmā "who has terror for protection", king of Utkala, younger brother of Candavarmā; he wanted to marry Mañjuvādinī; Viśruta killed him with a dagger throw during an acrobatics show.
pracaya [act. praci] m. picking; collection; accumulation | heap; mass; multitude | increase — f. pracayā ifc. picking of. puspapracayas cauryena fruit picking by flight.
pracayana [act. praci] n. gathering; collection.
pracar [pracar] v. [1] pr. (pracarati) pr. r. (pracarate) pp. (pracarita) to advance, to wander; to appear, to take place; to arrive at (acc.) | to be busy (loc.); to practice.
pracarita [pp. pracar] amnf pracaritā practiced; carried out; visited.

pracal [pracal] v. [1] pr. (pracálati) pp. (pracalita) to move, advance, depart; to deviate | to tremble, to agitate. vṛkṣaḥ pracalan sahāvayavaiḥ pracalati [Mahābhāṣya] When a tree trembles, it trembles in all its parts (expresses the coherence of the syntax).

pracalita [pp. pracal] amnf pracalitā set in motion; agitated, displaced; rolled (eyes) gone | confused, perplexed, disconcerted | current, common, usual | recognized, preferred; received as at tority — n. departure.
pracāya [act. praci] m. picking (of fruits).
pracāyika [ika] amnf pracāyikā who picks (fruits) — act. f. pracāyikā picking (fruits). tava puspapracāyikah it's your turn to pick fruit.
pracāra | act. pracar | m. manifestation, ap appearance; exhibition | employment, use | practice; conduct | prevalence; custom, usage | place of exercise; playing field | pasture; access route.

praci [praci] v. [5] pr. (pracinóti) pr. r. (pra cinuté) pp. (pracita) to gather, assemble, collect, pick.

pracit [pracit₁] v. [3] pr. (praciketti) pr. r. (pracikitte) pp. (pracikita) to know; to make known, to manifest oneself; to appear — ca. (pracetayati) to make oneself seen; to manifest, to make appear — des. (pracikit sati) to show.
pracita [pp. pracit] amnf pracitā as seemed, gathered; picked, gathered | covered with, filled with (iic. i.).
pracud | pracud | ca. (pracodáyati) pp. (praco dita) ppr. (pracodayat) to throw, to cast | to incite, to press; to excite, to stimulate; to order, to demand.
pracudita [pp. pracud] amnf pracuditā thrown, hurled.

pracura amnf pracurā numerous; abundant, frequent; opp. alpa — ifc. full of, abundant in (iic.) — iic. many (ifc.). pracurībhū to increase, to proliferate. pracurīkṛ to make abundant; to increase, to cause to increase. pracurakarpūrasaviśeṣaśiśiracandana rasacchaṭāsāranikaradanturitabālakadalī pattrasaṃvāhanādivyāpāratvaramāṇasahacarī sārthaviracitopanītakamalinīdalajalārdra śayanīye On a moist bed of water, lotus leaves brought and applied by the troop of her attendants, who hasten to rub it, etc., with young banana leaves, thickened by a mass of showers of quantity of sandalwood juice having acquired a particular freshness (by its mixture with) abundant camphor (V. Henry).
pracuracandana [candana] n. a lot of sandalwood.

prácetas [pracetas] amnf attentive, observant, informed; thoughtful, wise (said of the gods) — m. myth. np. of Pracetā₁, epith. of Varuṇa "who knows all" | myth. np. of King Pracetā₂, descendant of Druhyu | myth. epith. of Agni | pl. pracetasas myth. the ten Pracetās, sons of Prācīnabarhi; when they entered the ocean to do a long ascetic practice, the world became a forest; on their return they created the wind and fire to burn it, but Soma protected it and gave them as wives the apsara Māriṣā₁, who gave birth to Dakṣa.
pracodaka [agt. pracud] amnf pracodikā instigator.
pracodana [act. pracud] n. instigation, incitement; order, command; saying.
pracodita [pp. ca. pracud] amnf praco ditā leads to, incites, forces, orders ( dat. ). cāpalāya pracoditaḥ incites to do a rash act.
pracodin [agt. pracud] amnf pracodinī instigator.
pracchad₁ [prachad₁] pp. (pracchanna) ca. (pracchādayati) to cover, to wrap; to hide.

pracchada [agt. pracchad₁] m. blanket. স হস্তর pracchanna [pp. pracchad₁] amnf prac channā covered; hidden.

prach cf. praś.
prajan [prajan] v. [4] pr. r. (prajāyate) pp. (prajāta) to be born, to arise | to procreate — ca. (praja nayati) to engender, to produce; to evoke, to suggest.
prajana [act. prajan] mn procreation, generation; offspring | progenitor. prajanārtham adv. for the purposes of procreation.
prajanana |act. prajan| n. procreation, generation; offspring; production.
prajalp [prajalp] v. [1] pr. (prajalpati) by ler, say, tell; communicate, proclaim. স্ত্ৰ prajalpa | prajalpa | mr. chatter; idle gossip.
prajalpita [pp. prajalp] amnf prajal pitā said, utterance | who began to speak — n. words spoken; speech.

prajavin [prajavin] amnf prajavinī who hurries; swift, rapid — m. steed. স্ত্রা prajā [act. prajan] f. procreation; offspring; descendant; race, posterity | creature, man; subject | pl. prajās subjects (of the kingdom); children, offspring; race, lineage | fr. progeny. yathā rājā tathā prajā [SRBh.] Like king, like people.
prajākāma [kāma] m. desire for offspring — amnf prajākāmā who desires offspring.

prajāpati [pati] m. myth. np. of the demiurge prajāpati "the Lord of creatures", epithet of the male half Virāţ of Brahmā the Creator; astr. he presides over the nakṣatra of Rohiṇī₁; he committed primordial incest with his daughter Uṣā in the form of a deer [mṛga], and was pinned to heaven as Mṛgaśiras by Rudra; phil. [Sāmkhya] he is the regent [niyantr] of the reproductive faculty | upastha|; he is sometimes invoked as Ka "him"; he personifies the 5th year of a life cycle [saṃvatsara]; [SP.] he created the Universe by uttering bhūr bhuvar svaḥ | phil. prajāpati is also the Cosmos [Puruṣa] dismembered into the 5 directions of space | diś₂ | myth. demiurge in general; not. one of the 10 progenitors, spirits originating from Brahmā (or created by ManuSvāyaṃbhuva) to populate the world; the traditional list of progenitors includes the 7 patriarchs [saptarși]: Marīci, Atri, Angirā, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Vasistha, to which are added: Dakṣa, Bhṛgu and Nārada; Gautama, Bharadvāja, Viśvāmitra, Jama dagni, Kaśyapa, Tvaṣṭā, and also Kardama are also sometimes included.
prajārtha [artha] m. purpose of procreation. prajārthe var. prajārtham for the purpose of procreation.
prajāvat [vat] amnf prajāvatī prolific; fruc killer — f. prajāvatī pregnant woman.
prajāhita [hita₂] amnf prajāhitā favorable to the race; beneficial to the subjects.
prajotpatti [utpatti] f. the act of raising offspring. prajotpattyānupūrvyeṇa according to the order of seniority.
Prajāgara [agt. prajāgr] amnf prajāgarā who watches — m. guardian, watcher | myth. np. of Prajāgara, epith. of Viṣṇu "He who watches (over us)" — act. m. wakefulness, deprivation of sleep.
prajāgr [prajāgr] v. [1] pr. (prajāgarti) watch ter (l.).
prajīvana [prajīvana] n. means of subsistence.

prajīvin [prajīvin] m. bed. [PT.] np. of Prajīvī, minister of the raven king Meghavarņa. সর prajña [agt. prajñā₁] amnf prajñā educated, learned; wise — ifc. who knows (iic.). pathiprajña who knows the path well.

Prajñopāyaviniścayasiddhi [upāyaviniścaya siddhi] f. bed. n.p. from the Prajñopāyaviniścayasiddhi "Perfect Knowledge of the Path of Wisdom", phil. from the master comics. Anangavajra. সরম prajñapta [pp. That. prajñā₁] amnf prajñaptā prescribed; ordered | arranged (seat). সর্মি prajñapti [act. prajñā₁] f. information; instruction, teaching | appointment; agreement | arrangement (seat). সরা prajnā₁ [prajnā₁] v. [9] pr. (prajānāti) pr. r. (prajānīté) pp. (prajñāta) pf. (sam) to recognize, distinguish; to be familiar with | to know; to perceive; to discover; to learn — ca. (prajñāpayati) to show (the way, the method) | to summon, to invite. সরা prajnā₂ [act. prajnā₁] f. knowledge, Wisdom, judgment; intuition; intelligence | bd. Wisdom, one of the 6 perfections [pāramitā] of an accomplished [bodhisattva] | lit. [Tantra] designates the yoginī in bd. erotic symbolism.

Prajñākaragupta |ākaragupta| m. hist. np. of the master bd. Prajñākaragupta (8th century); we owe to him the treatise Pramāṇavārttikālaṃkarabhāṣya, commentary on the means of knowledge according to Dhar makīrti.
Prajñākaramati [ākaramati] m. hist. n.p. by Prajñākaramati, comic master. teacher in Vi kramaśīla in the 9th century; we owe him the commentary [pañjikā] of the Bodhicaryāvatāra.
prajñācakṣus [cakṣus] amnf wise, intelligent
blind ["who has intelligence for an eye"].
prajñānairātmyā [nairātmyā] f. bd. [Tantra] n.p. of prajñānairātmyā "who knows in-trinsic emptiness", consort of Hevajra.
prajñāparadha [aparādha] m. med. [Caraka] at tincture to common sense, as a frequent cause of pathology.

Prajñāpāramitā [pāramitā] f. bd. Perfect Wisdom (one of the cardinal virtues of Buddhism) | bd. np. of Prajñāpāramitā, Wisdom personified | bd. family of texts giving the Buddha's teachings through his dialogues with disciples and gods; cf. Astasāhasrikā, Pañcavimsatisahasrikā, Vajracchedikā, Akṣobhya, Pañcaśatikā. Holy bhagavatī Prajñāpāramitā the Prajñāpāramitā.
prajñāpāramitāśāstra [śāstra] n. bd. n.p. Prajñāpāramitāśāstra or Mahāprajñā of the pāramitāsāstra; cf. Prajñāpāramitāsūtra.
Prajñāpāramitāsūtra [sūtra] n. bd. n.p. of the Prajñāpāramitāsūtra "Treatise on the Great Virtue of Wisdom", due to Nāgārjuna.
prajñāpti [āpti] f. bd. denotation of a word.
prajñāptimātra [mātra] n. bd. [Madhyamaka] "simple conceptual construction", qualifies the emptiness of phenomena, due to ignorance of absolute reality.
prajñāptirūpādāya [rūpaādāya₁] m. bd. [Madhyamaka] intellectual interpretation of a phenomenon.
Prajñābhadra | bhadra | m. hist. np. from the Bengali paṇḍita Prajñābhadra "Who excels in Wisdom" (989–1069); bd. he became the Perfect [mahāsiddha] Tilopa.
prajñāloka |loka| m. phil. [yoga] ["place of knowledge"] divine vision or knowledge.

prajñāvarman | varman | mr. hist. n.p. by Prajñāvarmā "Protected by his Wisdom", literate bd. from the court of king Pāla Gopāla; he is the author of the Udānavargavivaraņa. সরাব prajñāta [pp. prajñā₁] amnf prajñātā known, recognized, discovered; well known, notorious. সরান prajñāna [agt. prajñā₁] amnf prajñānī sage | easy to know — n. Wisdom, knowledge, intelligence | distinctive sign, identifier, characteristic.
prajñānaghaná | ghana | m. phil. understanding in its pure state.
prajval [prajval] v. [1] pr. (prajvalati) pp. (prajvalita) pf. (sat) to ignite; to be lit (fire, lamp) — ca. (prajvālayati) pp. (prajvālita) to light; set fire to, ignite.
prajvalana [act. prajval] n. act of burning.
prajvalanīya [pfp. [2] prajval] amnf prajvalanīyā flammable.
prajvalita [pp. prajval] amnf prajva litā lit, inflamed; That which burns, That which shines — n. combustion.
prajvālana |act. ca. prajval| n. act of lighting; ignition. dīpaprajvālana n. lighting of the lamp at the inauguration of a congress of scholars.
prajvālita [pp. That. prajval] amnf prajvālitā lit, maintained (fire).
praṇata |pp. praṇam| amnf praṇatā bent, inclined; subject to.
praṇad [pranad] v. [1] pr. (praṇadati) pp. (pranadita) to start shouting; to howl, to roar.
praṇapāt [pranapāt] m. great-grandson.

praṇam [pranam] v. [1] pr. (praṇamati) pr. r. (pranamate) pp. (pranata) abs. (pranamayya) to bow, to bow respectfully before (dat. g. loc. acc. rangle — ca. (praṇamayati) pp. (praṇamita) to make bow (acc.) (before (dat.)); to bow. dandavat pranam to prostrate oneself face down ["like a stick"].
praṇamana |act. praṇam| n. respectful greeting, the act of bowing before g. iic. .
pranamayya | pranam | adv. while bowing.

praṇaya [act. praṇī] m. familiarity, intimacy, trust (in (loc.)); friendship, affection, love; manifestation; desire for (loc.) — iic. the act of exhibiting or pretending to be (ifc.). pranayena var. pranayāt adv. in confidence, openly. pranayakope adv. feigning anger. pranayīkr to draw near. pranayībhū to become intimate.
pranayin |in| amnf pranayinī familiar, friend, favorite; One who has affection for (g.) — m. lover, worshipper — f. praṇayinī beloved; cherished wife.
praṇayana [act. praṇī] n. act of bringing; container for transporting | execution, performance; practice; composition.
praṇava [act. praṇu] m. phil. ("buzzing") the sacred syllable om 🕉 | small drum — f. praṇavā ifc. buzzing of
praṇavopāsana | upāsana | n. recitation of om 🕉.
praṇaś [pranaś₁] v. [4] pr. (praṇaśyati) pp. (pranașța) disappear; escape; get lost.
praṇasa [pranasa] amnf praṇasā with a prominent nose.
pranāda [agt. pranad] m. cry; cry of joy, ap. applause; intense noise.
praṇāma [act. praṇam] m. respectful greeting, reverence. sapranāmam adr. respectfully yours.
praṇāyaka [agt. praṇī] m. guide, leader; commander (of an army).
pranigad [pranigad] v. [1] pr. (pranigadati) to declare; to say something to someone. 2 acc. .

praṇidhā [pranidhā] v. [3] pr. (praṇidadhāti) pp. (praṇihita) to deposit, to lay down; to approach (acc.) | to direct (one's eyes, mind) on (loc.); to become absorbed in (loc.); to fix one's attention, to reflect, to meditate.
praṇidhāna [act. praṇidhā] n. respect, submission, devotion; deep meditation, absorption.
praṇidhi [act. praṇidhā] m. observer; spy | emissary; secret agent; servant solicitation, request; prayer.
praṇinad [praninad] v. [1] pr. (praṇinadati) to make a thunderous noise.

praṇipat [pranipat] v. [1] pr. (praṇipatati) pp. (pranipatita) to throw oneself at someone's feet; to prostrate oneself before (acc. dat. loc.) — ca. (praṇipātayati) to cause someone to prostrate themselves. pranipatya ind. having prostrated themselves. cyavanāya mām pranipātaya gives my respects to Cyavana.
pranipatana [act. pranipat] n. reverence; the act of throwing oneself at the feet of.
pranipatita [pp. pranipat] amnf pranipatitā prostrate, bowing respectfully.
pranipāta [act. pranipat] m. reverence, his lutatation, prostration; act of throwing oneself at the feet of (g.) — agt. f. pranipātā ifc. who prostrates himself before (iic.).
praṇihan [pranihan] v. [2] pr. (praṇihanti) pp. (pranihata) to strike, to knock down; to kill, to destroy, ex to shoot.

pranihita [pp. pranidhā] amnf pranihitā deposited, applied | directed towards, fixed upon, absorbed into (loc.) | delivered, entrusted to (dat.) | contained in (iic.) | laid down, affirmed; admitted; resolved, determined.
pranihitadhī [dhī₂] f. guided meditation.

praṇī [pranī₁] v. [1] pr. (praṇayati) pp. (pranīta) pf. (sam) to lead; to carry (not. water, fire or soma on the altar) | to execute, to accomplish; to inflict (punishment) | to establish, to fix; to compose (work); to teach | to show affection, to love, to desire.

práṇīta [pp. praṇī] amnf praṇītā leads, brings, carries; not. carried to the altar (water, fire, soma) | established; composed; learned, inculcated | launched; inflicted; reduced to | offered; said not. of a son obtained by the blessing of a sage — ifc. composed by (iic.) — f. pranītā pl. soc. consecrated water.
praṇīya [praṇī] amnf praṇīyā to lead in front.
praṇu [pranu₁] v. [2] pr. (praṇauti) pp. (pranuta) to hum; not. to sing or murmur the sacred syllable om 🕉.
praṇud [pranud] v. [6] pr. (praṇudati) pp. (pranunna) to push, to set in motion; to repel, to drive away.
praṇetṛ [agt. praṇī] amnf praṇetrī guide; creator, master; promulgator of a doctrine.
pratan [pratan₁] v. [5] pr. (pratanóti) pr. r. (pratanuté) pp. (pratata) to produce, execute; to reveal, manifest; to undertake, begin, propagate.
pratanu | pratanu | amnf pratanū f. pra tanvī very fine, very thin; slender, delicate | minuscule, negligible.
pratanusalila |salila| amnf pratanusalilā to the almost dried up flow.

pratap [pratap] v. [1] pr. (pratapati) pr. r. (pratapate) pp. (pratapita, pratapta) to give off heat, to warm; to burn; to shine; to illuminate; to inflict burns, to torture — ps. (pratapyate) to suffer — ca. (pratāpayati) to warm; to heat; to set on fire | to radiate, to illuminate | to cause suffering, to burn; to torment, torment.
pratapa [act. pratap] m. heat of the Sun. ਸ਼ਰਸ pratapta [pp. pratap] amnf prataptā burning; heated to red; annealed | subjected to red-hot iron, tortured.
pratark [pratark] v. [10] pr. (pratar kayati) pp. (pratarkita) pfp. (pratarkya) to consider as; to imagine, to conceive.
pratarka [act. pratark] m. conjecture.
pratarkya [pfp. [1] pratark] amnf pra tarkyā imaginable, conceivable.

Pratardana [agt. pratṛd] amnf pratardanī who pierces; spearman | myth. [KB.] np. of the rājarṣi Pratardana, son of King Divodāsa and Mādhavī; he reigned over Kāśī; hymns of the Rigveda are attributed to him; Vatsa₁ is his son; [Mah.] he pursued his enemy VītahavyaHaihaya, who took refuge with Bhṛgu and became a sage | myth. epith. of Viṣṇu "who skewers".
pratāna | agt. pratan | m. shoot, bud; branching.
pratāpa |agt. pratap| m. Majesty | "like the burning Sun"]; name of princes — f. Pratāpī myth. np. of the pretty nymph [apsaras] Pratāpī, wife of Pramati, mother of Ruru.

Pratāparudra₁ | rudra | m. hist. np. of Pratāparudra₁, last emperor of the Kākatīyās, son of Queen Rudrāmbā; he reigned in Ekaśilā (1290–1323); he fought the Delhi Sultanate under the Khilji and then under the Tughluk; Ulugh Khān took the fort of Ekaśilā (mod. Warangal) in 1323 and imprisoned Pratāparudra₁, who committed suicide by throwing himself into the Narmadā | hist. np. of King Pratāparudra₂ or pratāparudradeva "Rudra the Majestic", son of King Gajapati Purusottamadeva₁; He claimed to be descended from the Sūryavamśī lineage; he reigned over Kalinga from 1497 to 1540; his capital was Kataka; he fought the Sultan of Bengal Allaudi Hussain Shah in the North and Vīra₁ Narasimha₆, king of Vijayanagara in the South; he patronized scholars, not. Raghunātha₁ Siromani; he is the author of several works on law [smṛti], erotics and magic; cf. Sarasvatīvilāsa.
pratāparudradeva [deva] m. hist. cf. Pratāparudra₂.
Pratāparudrayaśobhūṣaṇa [yaśasbhūṣaṇa] n. bed. n.p. from the Pratāparudrayaśobhūṣaṇa of Vidyānātha; cf. pratāparudrīya.

pratāparudrīya [īya] n. lit. np. of the pratāparudrīya, a work of rhetoric in the form of a praise of King Pratāparudra₁ by Vidyānātha (early 14th century), in 9 sections [prakaraṇa]; Kumārasvāmī made a commentary on it.
pratāpavat [vat] amnf pratāpavatī majes killers; powerful.

pratāpana |agt. pratap| amnf pratāpanī that burns, that torments — m. myth. epith. of Shiva | bd. np. of pratāpana, one of the 8 burning hells, where the damned are impaled on a white-hot trident — act. n. burning, torment.
pratār [ca. pratr̄] v. [10] pr. (pratāráyati) to deceive, mislead; to seduce, persuade dat. loc. .
pratāraka [agt. pratr] amnf pratārikā who deceives.

práti prep. in the opposite direction, in opposition, in return; against | towards, opposite, facing (acc.) | respectively to, with regard to acc. ; according to (acc.) — pf. distributive, of repetition — ifc. towards (i.e.); about, concerning (i.e.); against | small amount of (i.e.) | gr. pi rho tau i. vrkṣaṃ prati in the direction of the tree. mām prati in my eyes, according to me. varṣaṃ prati every year. śabdam prati in the direction of the sound. sukhaprati ind. a portion of pleasure. devasyāsvāsthyam prati Concerning Your Majesty's indisposition.
pratikaṇṭham [pratikaṇṭha] adv. [“throat by throat”] individually, one by one.
pratikāma [pratikāma] amnf pra tikāmā desired. pratikāmam according to one’s desire.
pratikāra [act. pratikṛ] m. reaction, opposition; prevention; remedy | retribution, reward, compensation; revenge | var. pratīkāra id.
pratikūla [pratikūla] amnf pra

tikūlā ["on the opposite bank"] opposite, contrary, disagreeable; unfavorable, adverse, hostile, enemy; opp. anukūla | soc. inverti — n. adversity — v. [11] pr. (pratikūlayati) inf. (pratikūlayitum) to resist; to oppose. pratikūlam adv. on the contrary, conversely, to the opposite; in the reverse order.
pratikṛ [pratikṛ₁] v. [8] pr. (pratikaróti) pp. (pratikṛta) to reward, to repay (g. dat. loc.) to return the favor, to pay back | to react, to resist, to oppose (acc.).
pratikṛta [pp. pratikṛ] amnf pratikṛtā returned, reversed; paid in return — n. reward; reimbursement | resistance, opposition.
pratikram [pratikram] v. [1] pr. (pra tikrāmati) pp. (pratikrānta) to return, to go back, to confess.
pratikrama [act. pratikram] m. reverse order.
pratikramaṇa [act. pratikram] n. soc. confession.

pratikriyā [act. pratikṛ] f. compensation, retribution; reward, aid | opposition, reaction; remedy — ifc. that which avoids, that which combats (iic.) (not. disease). pratikriyam adv. in reaction, tit for tat.
pratikṣaṇam [pratikṣaṇa] adv. at any time; continuously.
pratikṣapam [pratikṣapā] adv. every night.
pratikṣip [pratikṣip] v. [6] pr. (pratiksipati) pp. (pratiksipta) to throw into (loc.); to push against, to hurt | to reject, to oppose, to contradict; to refute; to ridicule.
pratikṣipta [pp. pratikṣip] amnf pratiksiptā launched into; sent | rejected.
pratikṣetram [pratikṣetra] adv. to all rights.
pratiksepa [act. pratiksip] m. contestation; objection, contradiction, refutation; repudiation.
pratikṣepaṇa [act. pratikṣip] n. contradiction, opposition, dispute.
pratigata [pp. pratigam] amnf pratigatā returned, returned.
pratigam [pratigam] v. [1] pr. (pratigac chati) pp. (pratigata) to go to meet; to turn around, to return; to go back to acc. . sabhyā svam svam sthānam pratijagmuḥ the gathering dispersed.
pratigṛham [pratigṛha] adv. in each house.
pratigrhya [pfp. [1] pratigrah] amnf pratigrhyā to accept; acceptable (of (g.)).
pratigṛ [pratigṛ₂] v. [9] pr. (pratigṛṇāti) pr. r. (pratigṛṇīte) invoke; greet, celebrate | respond by singing | approve (dat.).

pratigrah [pratigrah] v. [9] pr. (prati grhnāti) pr. r. (pratigrhnīté) pp. (pratigrhīta) to take, to seize; to receive, to accept; to welcome — ca. (pratigrāhayati) to cause to take, to give, to render.
pratigrahá [act. pratigrah] m. acceptance (not. of offerings) | gift, donation | soc. donation to a brahmin, one of the 6 duties of a brahmin |satkarmāni|. pratigraham kr to receive gifts.
pratigrahana [act. pratigrah] n. reception ; acceptance.
pratigrāhya [pfp. [1] pratigrah] amnf pratigrāhyā to accept; acceptable (of (g.)).
pratigha [act. pratihan] m. opposition, obstruction, resistance; repulsion; struggle against (i.e.) | anger, hatred; combat.
praticchanda [pratichanda] m. reflected image | image; likeness; portrait.
praticchandaka [ka] m. id. udyānam praviśya kumāram dṛṣṭvā praticchanda kam ācchādayati He enters the garden, sees the young man, and hides the portrait.
pratijaná [pratijana] m. opponent.
pratijanam [pratijana] adv. for each individual.
pratijanus [pratijanus] adv. at each birth.

pratijñā₁ [pratijñā₁] v. [9] pr. (pratijānāti) pr. r. (pratijānīte) pp. (pratijñāta) to admit, to recognize; to approve, to consent to; to affirm, to confirm | to promise to someone. (g. dat.) something. (acc. dat. inf.) | phil. [nyāya] to put forward as a thesis.

pratijnā₂ [act. pratijnā₁] f. act of admitting; Promise, commitment; affirmation; word, oath, vow; agreement | phil. |nyāya| proposition, thesis to be demonstrated of the syllogism [pañcāvayava] | pali paţiññā. luptapratijña perjury. sādhyaviśistapakṣabodhakavacanam pratijñā phil. [Padakṛtya] The thesis is the affirmation of the validity of the fact that the subject [pakṣa] is qualified by the predicate [sādhya].
pratijnāyaugandharāyana | yaugandharāyana | n. bed. n.p. from the pratijñāyaugandharāyaṇa "Minister's Promise", drama [nāṭaka] attributed to Bhāsa.
pratijñāhāni [hāni] f. phil. [nyāya] refutation of the thesis.

pratijñāta [pp. pratijñā₁] amnf pra tijñātā admitted, acknowledged, approved; affirmed; promised, proposed. ekākinī pratijñā hi pratijñātam na sādhayet [nyāya] a simple assertion does not establish a demonstration.
pratidā [pratidā₁] v. [3] pr. (pratidadāti) to return, give back, give in return; to give in exchange | to give as a gift.
pratidāna [act. pratidā] n. gift, homage; present in return.
pratidina [pratidina] amnf pratidinā daily. pratidinam adv. daily, every day.
pratidivasam [pratidivasa] adv. every day, every day.
pratidṛś [pratidṛś₁] ps. (pratidṛśyate) appear.
pratinand [pratinand] v. [1] pr. (pratinan dati) pp. (pratinandita) to congratulate, to welcome (acc.); to receive willingly, to welcome with joy — ca. (pratinandayati) to rejoice.
pratinandita [pp. pratinand] amnf pratinanditā well received, kindly received.
pratinayana [act. pratini] n. look (directed towards oneself), examination, observation (by others), the act of being scrutinized.
pratinava [pratinava₁] amnf pratinavā fresh.
pratinavajapāpuspa [japāpuspa] n. freshly bloomed Chinese rose. pratinavajapāpusparakta red like a freshly bloomed Chinese rose.
pratināyaka [pratināyaka] m. lit. anti-hero, antagonist of the hero in the drama.
pratinidhā [pratinidhā] v. [3] pr. (pratini dadhāti) substitute.

pratinidhi [act. pratinidhā] m. substitution | substitute; agent; security deposit | image, statue; double | myth. not. statue in the image of the exiled Sitā, to serve as a substitute wife |yajamānī| for Rāma during his horse sacrifice — ifc. image of, substitute for (iic.). pratinidhīkṛ substitute (acc.) for (iic.).
pratinind [pratinind] v. [1] pr. (pratinin dati) pp. (pratinindita) to blame, to reprimand.
pratiniyata [pratiniyata] amnf pra tiniyatā determined; such.
pratinivṛt [pratinivṛt] v. [1] pr. r. (prati nivartate) pp. (pratinivṛtta) to return; return from (abl.) | escape. pratinivartamāna amn which returns from. pratinivartita amn brought back.
pratinī [pratinī₁] v. [1] pr. (pratinayati) to lead towards; to lead back; to mix with.
pratipakṣa [pratipakṣa] amnf pratipakṣā opposite, contrary, adverse; opp. satpaksa.

pratipatti [act. pratipad₁] f. acquisition; perception, observation; knowledge; gift of understanding, intelligence | supposition; observation; affirmation | act of giving; act of taking; action, conduct. kā pratipattih what to do? kimkartavyatā pratipattimūdha amn who doesn't know what to do. pratipattim dā to honor, to pay homage to.
pratipatha [pratipatha] m. return path. pratipatham adv. along the path | on the return path.
pratipathika [ika] amnf pratipathikā which goes along the path.

pratipad₁ [pratipad₁] v. [4] pr. r. (prati padyate) pp. (pratipanna) pf. (vi, sam) to enter, arrive, reach; to take place, occur | to walk, wander; to go into or upon; to return, come back; to take refuge (with (acc.)) | to resort to; to incur; to obtain, receive, take | to perceive, discover; to know, recognize; to accomplish; to establish | to affirm, promise; to accept, consent; to teach | bd. to follow the way — ca. (pratipādayati) to bring, procure; to cause to be taken; to give, offer. padavīm pratipadya by following the path. ācārampratipadyasva accomplish the traditional salvation. karoti yādrśam karma tādrśam pratipadyate |Mah.| The result is a consequence of the action. āgamaprāmānyād apīśvaram pratipadyāmahe [AD.] We know that God exists by the authority of the Scriptures.

pratipád₂ [act. pratipad₁] f. entrance; access the right path to follow; the right way beginning, commencement | lit. introductory verse | astr. first day [tithi] of a lunar fortnight [pakṣa]; its regent is Agni; this day is favorable for any ceremony, not. śuklapratipad | var. pratipadā id. | var. pratipadī id.
pratipaccandra [candra] m. moon of the first day, new moon; soc. it is greeted with reverence.

pratipada [pratipada] n. lit. np. of the prati pada, an upāṅga — iic. step by step, one by one; cessational succ. pratipadam adv. step by step, one by one; successively | gram. word by word; for each word | each one; in isolation | on every occasion; in every place, everywhere literally; expressly.

pratipadārtha [artha] m. gram. meaning of successive words in a sentence. স্বারিদর pratipanna [pp. pratipad₁] amnf prati pannā arrived, attained or obtained; who has come to, who has won | understood, known; recognized, admitted; familiar to (loc.) | accepted, promised, consented.
pratipaś [pratipaś] v. [4] pr. (pra tipaśyati) to look, perceive, consider; compare | to feel, experience.
pratipā [pratipā₂] ca. (pratipāláyati) ppr. (pratipālayat) to protect; to observe, to maintain; at tend.
pratipātram [pratipātra] adv. lit. (theatre) relating to each actor.
pratipādaka [agt. pratipad₁] amnf pratipādikā that causes to be obtained, that gives (iic.) (to (loc.)) | that shows, that presents, that teaches, that explains (iic.).

pratipādana [act. pratipad₁] n. that which causes to be obtained, that which gives, that which grants | return, restoration, act of rendering | installation, inauguration; nomination to (loc.) | production, accomplishment | explanation, illustration, teaching action, behavior.

pratipādita [pp. ca. pratipad₁] amnf pratipāditā proposed; presented | established, proven; explained, taught | produced, provoked — n. proposition, thesis — f. pratipāditā given in marriage (to ⟨g.⟩). athopakośā vidhivat pitrā me pratipāditā [KSS.] Then Upakośā was given to me in marriage by her father according to custom.

pratipūrana [pratipūrana] n. filling; pouring of fluids into a cavity. atha hāsya vedam upaśṛṇvatas trapujatubhyām śrotrapratipūraņam udāharane jihvācchedo dhāraņe śarīrabhedaḥ | Gautamadharmasūtra | Now, if he (a śūdra) intentionally listens to the Veda, molten tin or lacquer will be poured into his ears; if he recites it, his tongue will be cut out, and if he withholds it, his body will be cut in two.
pratipratta [pp. pratipradā] amnf pra tiprattā returned, returned; issued.
pratipradā [pratipradā] v. [3] pr. (pratipra dadāti) pp. (pratipratta) to give back, to return.
pratipradāna [act. pratipradā] n. giving back.
pratiprabrū [pratiprabrū] v. [2] pr. (prati prabravīti) to answer someone. (acc.).
pratiprayam [pratiprayam] v. [1] pr. (pra tipryaccati) to return, to return.
pratipraśna [pratipraśna] m. question to a question.
pratipraśnottara | uttara₁ | m. answer to a question tion to a question.

pratiprasava [pratiprasava] m. counter-order; exception to a prohibition | gram. exception to a previous sūtra; counter-exception | phil. [Vedānta] return to the original state (by regression of the qualities [guṇa] in thought [citti]).
pratiprasthātṛ [pratiprasthātṛ] m. ved. one of the 3 priests assisting the adhvaryu in the solemn sacrifice.
pratiprasthāna [pratiprasthāna] n. function, local pratiprasthātr.
pratiphal [pratiphal] v. [1] pr. (pratipha lati) to rebound; to be thoughtful; to bear fruit, to give back.
pratiphala [agt. pratiphal] m. reflection; shadow.
pratiphalana [act. pratiphal] n. reflection; shadow | return; retaliation, reprisals.

pratibaddha [pp. pratibandh] amnf pratibaddhā bound, attached, fixed | braided (garland) | dependent on, subject to (i.e.) | connected to, equipped with (i.e.) | which harmonizes with (loc.) | excluded, prevented; kept at a distance | tangled, complicated | disappointed; square against; vexed.
pratibadhya [pfp. [1] pratibandh] amnf pratibadhyā obstructed; prevented; not produced.

pratibandh [pratibandh] v. [9] pr. (pra tibadhnāti) v. [9] pr. r. (pratibadhnīté) pp. (pra tibaddha) pfp. (pratibadhya) to bind, fix, attach; to set, encase | to exclude, keep at a distance. mainamantarā pratibadhnīta do not interrupt it.

pratibandha [act. pratibandh] m. bond, obstacle, impediment, hindrance; resistance, opposition. Grammatical conditional | phil. [Nyāya] conditional inference; syn. vyāpti. pratibandho vyāptiḥ phil. [Nyāya] Inherence conditions (the thesis | pratijñā₂| to reason | hetu|). vastu vastunā janyate vastu ca vastusvabhāvam bhavet tasmāt vastudharmah pratibandhah phil. Nyāyamañjarī Substance is derived from substance, substance can also be its own nature; thus the true nature of a thing is to be conditioned (by the cause of its creation).
pratibandhakārin [kārin] amnf pratiband hakāriņī obstacle maker, obstructor.
pratibandhavat [vat] amnf pratibandhavatī which presents obstacles; difficult to achieve.
pratibandhābhāva [abhāva] m. absence of impediment.

pratibandhaka [agt. pratibandh] amnf pratibandhikā that prevents, that opposes; factor of obstruction — m. obstacle, hindrance. pratibandhakātyantābhāvatvam phil. state of constant absence of hindrance.
pratibandhakatā [tā] f. the state of being an obstacle.
pratibandhakatāvacchedaka [avacchedaka] m. phil. |NN.| delimiter of obstruction; characteristic of being an obstacle.
pratibādh [pratibādh] v. [1] pr. r. (pra tibādhate) pp. (pratibādhita) to repel, to prevent; to restrict | torment, to thwart.
pratibādhaka [agt. pratibādh] amnf pratibādhakā that repels, that prevents (iic.).
pratibādhana [act. pratibādh] n. act of repelling or preventing (g. acc. iic.).
pratibādhin [agt. pratibādh] amnf pratibādhinī who obstructs — m. opponent.
pratibāhu [pratibāhu] m. math. side op placed on the side [bāhu] of a quadrilateral.

pratibimba [pratibimba] n. reflection; not. reflection in the water of the disk of the Sun or the Moon | reflected image | pictorial representation, image; shadow. pratibimbīkr to reflect, to be in the image of; to represent.
pratibimbavat [vat] amnf pratibimbavatī as in a mirror.
pratibimbavāda [vāda] m. phil. doctrine of reflection of Abhinavagupta.
pratibudh [pratibudh₁] v. [1] pr. (prati bodhati) pr. r. (pratibudhyate) pp. (pratibuddha) to awaken, to notice.
pratibodha [act. pratibudh] m. knowledge.
pratibodhavat [vat] amnf pratibodhavatī endowed with knowledge.
pratibha [agt. pratibhā₁] amnf pratibhā intelligent — f. cf. pratibhā₂.

pratibhā₁ [pratibhā₁] v. [2] pr. (pratibhāti) pp. (pratibhāta) to appear; to be understood | to come to mind, to understand clearly. tava kathā satyeva pratibhāti your story is credible. bubhuksitam na pratibhāti kiñcit A hungry belly understands nothing.

pratibhā₂ [f. pratibha] f. intelligence; imaginative capacity, creativity; intuitive understanding; intuition; inspiration, genius | stroke of genius; sudden revelation | phil. [Yoga] direct experience gram. [Bhartrhari] sudden revelation of the global meaning of an utterance; flash of intuition of meaning; cf. sphota | lit. [KM.] inspiration of the poet; it can be creative [kārayitrī] or receptive [bhāvayitrī]; [Jagannātha₁] it is complemented by experience [vyutpatti] and practice [abhyāsa]. pratibhātas adv. in imagination. yā śabdagrāmam arthasārtham alankāratantram uktimārgam anyadapi tathāvidham adhihṛdayam pratibhāsayati sā pratibhā lit. [KM.] Inspiration is what causes the multitude of words, the flow of ideas, the pattern of ornamentation, the course of turns of phrase, and other similar processes to radiate in the mind.
pratibhāvat [vat] amnf pratibhāvatī gifted with inspiration; creative; intelligent | bold.
pratibhāna [act. pratibhā₁] n. sagacity; presence of mind | obviousness.
pratibhānavat [vat] amnf pratibhānavatī sa gace.
pratibhāṣ [pratibhāṣ] v. [1] pr. r. (Pra tibhāṣate) pp. (pratibhāṣita) answer someone. (acc.) | name (2 (acc.)).
pratibhāṣā [obj. pratibhāṣ] f. answer.
pratibhās [pratibhās₁] v. [1] pr. r. (Pra tibhāsate) to manifest; to appear as (nom.) | to be bright.
pratibhāsa [act. pratibhās] m. appearance; resemblance, similarity | mental image; illusion.
pratibhāsana [act. pratibhās] n. appearance; resemblance.
pratibhid [pratibhid₁] v. [7] pr. (pratibhi natti) pr. r. (pratibhintte) pp. (pratibhinna) to split, pierce.
pratibhū [pratibhū₂] m. deposit.
pratimā₁ [pratimā₁] v. [3] pr. r. (prati mimīte) v. [2] pr. (pratimāti) pp. (pratimita) imitate; copy.
pratimā₁ [agt. pratimā₁] m. ved. creator; craftsman, maker — act. f. likeness; image, symbol, figure; idol, statue; reflection — ifc. similar to (iic.).
pratimānāṭaka [nāṭaka] n. lit. np. of the Pra timānāṭaka, a play by Bhāsa based on the Rāmāyaṇa.
pratimāpūjā [pūjā] f. soc. worship of idols.
pratimāna [act. pratimā₁] n. model, pattern; resemblance, analogy.
pratimālā [pratimālā] f. the art of reciting verses backwards or according to other mnemonic arrangements, one of the 64 arts [kalā].

pratimukha [pratimukha] n. image of the wise man reflected in a mirror | [pratimukhasandhi] lit. [dramaturgy] epitasis, secondary event during the crescendo of the action, precipitating events; it is one of the 5 articulations of narrative
dramatic [pañcasandhi] — amnf pratimukhī who stands opposite, who faces; in front, before. pratimukham opposite; towards; in front, before.
pratimuhur [pratimuhur] adv. repeatedly; again and again.
pratimuhūrtam [pratimuhūrta] adv. at any time, constantly.
pratimūrti [pratimūrti] f. representation, image.
pratimokṣa [pratimokṣa] m. bd. recitation of the code of penances | var. prātimokṣa id.
Pratimokṣasūtra [sūtra] n. lit. np. of the Pratimokṣasūtra, code of conduct for monks, oldest known bd. text.
pratiyā [pratiyā₁] v. [2] pr. (pratiyāti) pp. (pratiyāta) to leave; return (from).
pratiyāta [pp. pratiyā] amnf pratiyātā returned, returned; party.
pratiyuj [pratiyuj₁] v. [7] pr. (pratiyu nakti) pr. r. (pratiyuńkté) pp. (pratiyukta) to pay, return (not. a debt) — ca. (pratiyojayati) to fix (the arrow to the bow).
pratiyudh [pratiyudh₁] v. [4] pr. r. (prayud hyate) v. [4] pr. (prayudhyati) pp. (pratiyuddha) to fight against; measure oneself against; combat.
pratiyūthapa [pratiyūthapa] m. leader of an opposing horde (of elephants).
pratiyoga [act. pratiyuj] m. resistance, op position | remedy, antidote.
pratiyogi iic. pratiyogin.
pratiyogika [ka] amnf pratiyogikā an tithétique, contradictoire | relative, corrélatif.
pratiyogitā [tā] f. partnership, cooperation | phil. [NN.] fact of being in inverse relation with (iic. loc.); contrapositivity; opp. anuyogitā.
pratiyogitāka [ka] amnf pratiyogitākā phil. [NN.] which is the contrapositive of (iic.).
pratiyogitva [tva] n. id.

pratiyogin [agt. pratiyuj] amnf pra tiyoginī ifc. related to (iic.); opposed, contrary to (iic.) — m. adversary, rival, opponent; partner | gram. absence | phil. [NN.] domain of origin of a relational qualification; opp. anuyogin.
pratiyodha [agt. pratiyuj] m. opponent, adversary.
pratiyodhana [act. pratiyuj] n. mutual combat, duel.
pratiyodhin [agt. pratiyuj] m. opponent, adversary on his level.
pratiyoni [pratiyoni] adv. depending on the origin.
pratiruddha [pp. pratirudh] amnf prati ruddhā prevented, thwarted; stopped, interrupted; weakened.
pratirudh [pratirudh₂] v. [7] pr. (pratiruṇaddhi) pr. r. (pratirunddhe) pp. (prati ruddha) to resist, oppose, prevent; to hold in check.
pratirūp [pratirūp] v. [10] pr. (pra tirūpayati) pp. (pratirūpita) copy.
pratirūpa [act. pratirūp] n. copy.
pratirūpita [pp. pratirūp] amnf pra tirūpitā copied.
pratirodha [act. pratirudh] m. opposition, obstruction; stop.
pratilabh [pratilabh] v. [1] pr. r. (prati labhate) pp. (pratilabdha) to receive back, to take back, to recover | to receive a punishment in return to learn, to understand.
pratilābha [act. pratilabh] m. reception, obtaining, retrieval.
pratilikh [pratilikh] v. [6] pr. (pratilikhati) pp. (pratilikhita) to write back, to reply to a letter; to copy | to wipe, to clean.
pratilekhana [act. pratilikh] n. reply letter | copying exercise, calligraphy | soc. regular cleaning of instruments of daily use — f. pratilekhanā soc. id.

pratiloma [pratiloman] amnf pra tilomā backwards, against the grain, against the grain; unnatural | hostile, unpleasant | aberrant (said of an endogamous marriage where the woman has a superior status to the man); syn. viloma; opp. anuloma — f. pratilomā soc. magic formula pronounced backwards. pratilomena backwards; from right to left; opp. anulomena.
prativaktavya [pfp. [1] prativac] amnf prativaktavyā to which one must respond; to contradict | which must be given as a response.
prativaktṛ [agt. prativac] amnf prati vaktrī who answers (to (g.)); who explains the law.
prativac [prativac] v. [2] pr. (prativakti) pp. (pratyukta) to answer (2 acc.), to reply.
prativacana [act. prativac] n. response | echo.
prativad [prativad] v. [1] pr. (prativadati) pp. (pratyudita) to speak to (acc.); to answer, to respond to (acc.) | to repeat — intens. (prativāvadīti) to say against.
prativaditavya [pfp. [3] prativad] amnf prativaditavyā which must be contested, refuted or disputed.
prativap [prativap₂] v. [1] pr. (prativapati) pp. (pratyupta) to inlay (jewels); to insert, add; to decorate with, fill with (i.).
prativarṣam [prativarṣa] adv. every year.
prativasati [prativasati] adv. in every home.
prativākya [pfp. [1] prativac] n. answer — amnf prativākyā that can be answered.
prativāta [prativāta] m. contrary wind. prativātam adv. against the wind.
prativāda [act. prativad] m. contradiction; rejection; refusal | response; reply.

prativādin [agt. prativad] amnf pra tivādinī ifc. who responds to, who disobeys (iic.); who refutes, who denies, who contests (iic.) — m. interlocu teur; adversaire | phil. opposer of a thesis; opp. vādin | soc. (law) accused, indicted.
prativāsudeva [prativāsudeva] m. jn. eminent character [śalākāpuruṣa] of an epic, in the role of an antihero; not. Rāvaṇa, opposed to the hero Rāma, and Jarāsandha, opposed to the hero Krsna.
prativid [prativid₁] v. [2] pr. (prativetti) pp. (pratividita) to perceive; to understand — ca. (pra tivedayati) to say, to announce, to make known (2 acc.) | to offer, to give.
pratividhā [pratividhā₁] v. [3] pr. (prati vidadhāti) pp. (prativihita) arrange, prepare, dispose | prevent, act against (g.).
pratividhāna [act. pratividhā] n. measure against (g.), preventive means, precaution.
prativindhya [prativindhya] m. myth. [Mah.] np. of prativindhya, son of Yudhisthira and Draupadī; he killed King Citra₂ at the great ba taille, but was shot down by Aśvatthāmā during the night.
prativiśiṣ [prativiśiṣ] ps. (pratiśiṣyate) surpass (i.).
prativișa [prativișa] n. antidote.
prativeśa [prativeśa] m. neighbor.
prativeśika [ika] amnf prativeśikā neighbor.
prativeśin [in] amnf prativeśī neighbor — f. prativeśī neighbor.
pratisabda [pratisabda] m. echo.
pratiśabdaka [ka] m. id. pratiśabdaka iva rājavacanam anugacchati jano
bhayāt [K.] out of fear, people echo what the king says.
pratiśākhā [pratiśākhā] f. side branch | Vedic school or sect | pl. pratiśākhās as a whole of the Vedic schools pratiśākham adv. for all The schools of the Veda.
pratiśās [pratiśās] pp. (pratiśiṣṭa) com missioner.
pratiśāsana [act. pratiśās] n. act of commissioning, of sending a courier.
pratiśiṣṭa [pp. pratiśās] amnf pratiśiṣṭā sent on a mission, dispatched.
pratiśyāya [pratiśyāya] m. med. cold, cold.
pratiśravá [agt. pratiśru] amnf pratiśravā that responds; that echoes — act. m. pro mess, commitment, vow — f. pratiśravā ifc. id. pratiśravante adv. after the expiration of a pro mess.

pratiśru [pratiśru] v. [5] pr. (pratiśṛṇóti) pp. (pratiśruta) to hear, to listen; to lend an ear to (g.) to promise something (acc.) to someone (g. dat.); to commit to — des. (pratiśuśrūṣati) to want to promise. pūrvam artham pratiśrutya pratijñām hātum ic
chasi [Rām.] after promising something, you want to go back on your word.
pratiśrut [pratiśrut] f. echo.
pratiśruta [pp. pratiśru] amnf pratiśrutā heard | promised, accepted; not. promised in marriage. pratisrute adv. promise having been made.
pratiśruti [act. pratiśru] f. answer; pro messe.
pratiśrútkā [pratiśrutaka] f. echo.
pratisiddha [pp. pratisidh] amnf pratisiddhā repelled, prevented; forbidden.
pratisidh [pratisidh₂] v. [1] pr. (pratisedhati) pp. (pratisiddha) to repel, to set aside (dat.), to refuse, to prevent, to forbid.
pratiṣīv [pratisīv] v. [4] pr. (pratiṣīvyati) pfp. (pratiṣīvya) to sew on.
pratiṣīvya [pfp. [1] pratiṣīv] amnf pratiṣīvyā to sew on.

pratisedha [act. pratisidh] m. refusal, prohibition, interdiction | gram. exception | gram. negation, meaning of the privative prefix 'a'; the negation prasajyapratisedha of the tatpurușa compounds is distinguished from the exclusion paryudāsa of the bahuvrīhi compounds — v. [11] pr. (pratiṣedhayati) negate. vidhyuttarakālāh pratisedhā bhavanti gram. [Mahābhāṣya] Prohibitive rules are subsequent to prescriptive rules.
pratisedhya [act. pratisidh] amnf pratisedhyā which must be negated.

pratiṣṭha [agt. pratiṣṭhā₁] amnf pratiṣṭhā stable, firm, solid; famous — ifc. ending with, leading to, taking as its base (iic.) — n. point of support, center, base — f. cf. pratisthā₂. pratiṣṭhā hṛdyā jaghantha [RV.] You have touched me to the very heart.

pratisthā₁ [pratisthā₁] v. [1] pr. (pratitisthati) pr. r. (pratitisthate) pp. (pratisthita) pf. (sam) to extend, to rest upon (acc.) | to cease, to disappear, to set (star) — ca. (pratiṣṭhāpayati) to lead to, to bear upon (loc.) | to establish, to found, to support; to offer, to grant to someone (dat. loc.); to confer upon dat. loc. . pratisthāpayitavya which must be placed at the beginning. ਸਰਿষ্ঠা pratisthā₁ [f. pratistha] f. base, foundation, support; receptacle; pedestal | stability; perseverance; home, house; place of rest, comfort; place, position, high social dignity; rite, ceremony, consecration; accession to the throne; installation of an image; cf. prāṇapratiṣṭhā, lingapratisthā | phil. [śaivasiddhānta] stable aspect of the bindu associated with SadāśivaVāmadeva. gato'si sarvāsvāyudhavidyāsu parām pratisthām You have attained complete knowledge of all weapons.
pratisthācārya [ācārya] m. soc. religious person having the authority to consecrate sacred images.
pratisthātantra [tantra] n. lit. np. from pratisthā₁ tantra "Treatise on Consecrations", which codifies the installation and consecration of sacred images.
pratisthāpana [āpana] n. fixing, placement | not. erection or consecration of a sacred image.
pratisthālakṣaṇa [lakṣaṇa] n. characteristic attribute of a sacred image for the purpose of identifying the divinity [devatā] represented.
pratisthālakṣaṇasārasamuccaya [sārasam uccaya] m. lit. np. from the Pratisthālaksanasāra samuccaya, an 11th-century manual detailing the construction and installation of sacred images.

pratisthāna [act. pratisthā₁] n. base, pedestal; support, foundation | geo. [Mah.] ford [tīrtha] at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā; cf. prayāga | geo. np. of the city of Pratiṣṭhāna on the Godāvarī (mod. Paiṭhaṇa); it was the capital of the Sātavāhanās.

pratisthānapura | pura | n. geo. np. of the city of Pratisthānapura, at the confluence of the Gangā and the Yamunā (on the opposite bank to mod. Allahabad); myth. it was the capital of the first kings of the lunar lineage; Indra offered it to Sudyumna, who gave it to Purūravā.
pratiṣṭhāpita [pp. ca. pratiṣṭhā₁] amnf pratisthāpitā fixed, installed; erected.
pratisthita [pp. pratisthā₁] amnf pratisthitā situated, placed, laid; established, founded; fixed, firm, proven.
pratisthitatva [tva] n. the state of being established.
pratisaṃskāra [act. pratisaṃskṛ] m. restoration, repair.
pratisaṃskṛ [pratisaṃskṛ] pp. (pratisamskṛta) to repair, restore; to reissue.
pratisaṃhita [pp. pratisaṃdhā] amnf pratisamhitā aimed; directed towards.
pratisaṃhṛ [pratisaṃhṛ] v. [1] pr. (pratisamharati) pp. (pratisamhrta) to withdraw; to retain, to restrict, to prevent.
pratisad [pratisad₁] v. [1] pr. (pratisīdati) leave | have an aversion.
pratisamdhā var. pratisandhā [prati saṃdhā₁] v. [3] pr. (pratisaṃdadhāti) v. [3] pr. r. (pratisamdhatte) rearrange | adjust; fix (not. the arrow on the bowstring) | remember, recall; understand.
pratisaṃdhāna var. pratisandhāna [act. pratisandhā n. meeting, assembly; synthesis | transition between two periods | memory, the act of remembering.
pratisamdhi var. pratisandhi [act. prati sandhā m. reunion | rebirth; transition between two ages.

pratisará [agt. pratisr] m. [“that which makes a loop” | circle | cord or ribbon tied around the wrist or arm as an amulet (not. in the wedding ceremony); bracelet; syn. kautuka | garland | servant; rearguard — f. pratisarā ifc. id.
pratisarábandha [bandha] mn guard, protection pl. soc. set of magical formulas protecting against demons.
pratisarga [pratisarga] m. phil. secondary creation cycle, associated with the kalpa; opp. prākṛtasarga; cf. pañcalakṣaṇa.

pratisṛ [pratisṛ] v. [1] pr. (pratisarati) pp. (pratisrta) to oppose, to rush upon, to pounce on, to attack | to return, to come back home | to travel the country in all directions — ca. (pratisārayati) to bring back; to put back in its place | to remove, to remove, to separate.
pratiskīrņa [pp. pratiskr] amnf pra tiskīrnā mistreated.

pratiskṛ [pratikṛ] v. [6] pr. (pratiskirati) pft. r. (praticaskare) pp. (pratiskīrņa) to scatter, to tear to pieces. sa mugdhakāntāstanasangabhangurairurovidāram praticaskare nakhaiḥ lit. [SPV.] He (Narasimha) tore the (demon's) breast to shreds with his claws, bent with desire for his beloved's voluptuous breast.
pratispardh [pratispardh] v. [1] pr. r. (pra tispardhate) to rival, to compete with; to emulate.
pratispardhin [agt. pratispardh] amnf pratispardhinī emulator; rival | of. pratispardhinau opponents, adversaries.
pratihata [pp. pratihan] amnf pratihatā repelled, set aside, held back. pratihatam amangalam misfortune is averted (formula to ward off a bad omen).
pratihataraya [raya] amnf pratihatarayā whose current is prevented.
pratihatya [abs. pratihan] adv. in the opposite direction.

pratihan [pratihan₁] v. [2] pr. (pratihanti) pp. (pratihata) to repel, to set aside; to stop, to restrain, to prevent; to weaken | to keep closed (not. beyond) to attack, to assail; to strike, to wound; to offend.
pratiháraṇa [act. pratihṛ] n. act of repelling; rejection; avoidance.
pratihartṛ [agt. pratihṛ] m. he who repels or stops | soc. priest assistant to the udgātr in the solemn Vedic rite; he sings the final part of a hymn [pratāra].

pratihāra var. pratīhāra [agt. pratihṛ] mf pratihārī act of pressing, closing; act of holding back, stopping; act of pushing back | phon. contact of the tongue with the teeth when pronouncing dentals soc. syllables sung by the pratihartr when he begins to sing, at the last verse of a hymn | soc. magic formula pronounced on weapons | door; guardian, gatekeeper | [pratīhāra] hist. np. of a dynasty of West India | du. pratīhārau The two statues of guardians at the entrance of a temple — f. pratihārī soc. royal gatekeeper.
pratihṛ [pratihṛ₁] v. [1] pr. (pratiharati) pp. (pratihṛta) to throw, to hurl at (loc.) | to strike, to attack, to fight; to repel, to hold back | to press, to close by pushing, to keep closed.
pratihṛta [pp. pratihṛ] amnf pratihṛtā struck, wounded, beaten.
pratī₁ pf. prati.

pratī₂ [pratii] v. [2] pr. (pratyeti) pr. r. (pratīte) pp. (pratīta) pf. (sam) to go towards, to go against; to resist; to return, to come back to admit, to believe, to trust; to recognize — ca. (pratyāyayati) to convince, to make believe.

prátīka [pratiīka] amnf pratīkā opposite, inverted | symbolic — ifc. turned towards, directed towards, facing, opposite to, looking at (iic.) — n. exterior, surface; appearance | face, visage, forehead — m. image, symbol; copy; member, part | lit. quotation of a passage from the original text in a commentary; its first segment, used as an incipit | gram. focus of a grammatical commentary; e.g., a vārttika for bhāsya, a supporting example [udāharaṇa] or an operational detail for derivation [prakriyā], etc. | jn. symbol of the Jain religion
pratīkanāṭaka [nāṭaka] n. lit. allegorical drama.
pratīkāra cf. pratikāra.
pratīkāśa [pratī₁kāśa] m. resemblance.
pratīkṣ [pratiīkṣ] v. [1] pr. r. (pratīkṣate) pp. (pratīkṣita) to wait; to expect, to anticipate; to bear; to tolerate. kālaḥ kaścitpratīkṣyatām wait some time.

pratīkṣa [agt. pratīkṣ] amnf pratīkṣā who looks back — ifc. who expects, who anticipates, who is eager for (iic.) — act. f. cf. pratīkṣā. muhūrtam pratīkṣā karanīyā one must wait a while. sukhapratīkṣa who anticipates pleasure | of an optimistic nature.
pratīkṣā [f. pratīkṣa] f. anticipation; expectation, consideration, respect, veneration. tvayā pratīkṣā karanīyā you must wait.
pratīcī [f. pratyac] f. the direction of the West.
pratīcya [a] m. Western country; pl. its inhabitants. pratīcyeṣvarthamātrakam lit. [HC.] Western (poets) are concerned with meaning.
pratīta [pp. pratī₂] amnf pratītā recognized, approved; convinced of, confident; satisfied. pratīta ... iti known as ... |name.|.
pratītapadārtha [padārtha] m. gram. known meaning; intended meaning.
prátīti [act. pratī₂] f. obligatory consequence, inevitability; evidence | correct understanding; conviction; belief; faith | confidence; credit | reputation; respect.
pratītya [pfp. [1] pratī₂] amnf pratītyā to approve — n. comfort, consolation; confirmation; comfort — abs. ind. bd. having recognized (the origin of the manifestations).

pratītyasamutpāda [samutpāda] m. bd. The chain of causes of suffering; it has 12 stages: ignorance [avidyā], mental formation [saṃskāra], knowledge [vijñāna], name and form [nāmarūpa], The 6 perceptions
sensory [sadāyatana], contact [sparśa], the

sensation [vedanā], desire [tṛṣṇā], attachment [upādāna], existence [bhāva], birth [jāti] and decrepitude [jarā]; traversed in the opposite direction it becomes the "source of comfort" (through liberation) | pali paticchyasamutpada.
pratīndhaka [pratiindhaka] m. myth. |Rām.| np. of the king pratīndhaka Janaka, son of Maru, father of Kīrtiratha.

pratīpa [pratiap] amnf pratīpā against the current; against the grain, backwards | disagreeable, obstinate, retrograde — m. adversary, enemy | myth. |Mah.| np. of the kaurava king pratīpa "Grumpy" father of Devāpi, Sāṃtanu and Bāhlīka; cf. Gaṅgā — v. [11] pr. r. (pratīpāyate) to oppose, to be Hostile towards loc. .
pratīpaga [ga₁] amnf pratīpagā that goes against the current; that goes backwards.
pratīpokti [ukti] f. contradiction.
pratīpopamā [upamā₂] f. lit. rhet. inverted comparison (e.g., comparing the Moon to a face to praise its beauty).
pratīpaka [pratī₁paka₂] amnf pratīpakā opposite, contrary; Hostile — m. myth. [BhP.] np. of the king pratīpaka Janaka "the Hostile", son of Maru, father of Krtirāta.

pratīhārá [pratī₁hāra₁] m. [pratihāra] soc. porter | hist. np. of the Pratīhārās dynasty, founded by Nāgabhaṭa I; they reigned in the West of the Deccan, their capital was Bhinnaimala (mod. Bhinmal near Mount Abu) then Kanyākubjā Mahodayā (mod. Kanauj) from the 8th to the 12th century; cf. Mihirabhoja₁.
Pratīhārendurāja [indurāja] m. hist. np. of the rhetorician Pratīhārendurāja, student of Mukula (10th century); he is credited with a commentary on the Kāvyālankārasārasangraha.
pratuda [pratuda] m. ["that pecks" is said of birds such as the pigeon, the falcon, etc.
pratṛd [pratṛd] v. [7] pr. (pratṛṇatti) pp. (pratṛṇṇa) to pierce with a spear, to skewer.
pratṛ [pratṛ] v. [1] pr. (pratarati) pp. (pratīrṇa) to cross, to traverse — ca. (pratāráyati) to deceive, to mislead; to seduce, to persuade (dat. loc.).
pratolī f. gateway to a city.
pratta [contr. pradatta] amnf prattā given, offered, granted — f. prattā soc. promised in marriage.
pratná [pratna] amnf pratnā previous; ancient | usual; traditional, customary — n. phon. name of a meter.
pratnathā [thā] adv. as in the past; tradition nellement.
pratyak iic. pratyac.

pratyakṣa [pratiakṣa] amnf pratyakṣā before the eyes; visible, perceptible; manifest, clear, direct, immediate; real — n. ocular evidence | care of g. | phil. perception; direct observation, experience; [Nyāya] observation, one of the 4 means of legitimate knowledge [pramāṇa] — n. generic property. pratyakşam var. pratyakşe adv. in the presence of, in the sight of; publicly. pratyakṣīkṛ to make visible; to make evident, to reveal, to inspect, to verify with one's own eyes. nimīlitākṣo'ham pratyakṣīkaromi tvām yojanasa hasradūrasthasuhrdam With my eyes closed, I extend my friendship to you from a thousand steps away.
pratyakṣakaraṇa [karaṇa] n. phil. organ or means of perception.
pratyakṣakṛta |kṛta| amnf pratyakṣakṛtā soc. refers to a hymn in which the deity is addressed directly or in the 2nd person.
pratyakṣacārin [cārin] amnf pratyakṣacārinī moving in the field of view of g. .

pratyakṣapramā [pramā₂] f. phil. [Nyāya] correct knowledge arising from perception.
pratyakṣabrahman [bráhman] n. phil. support cos mongonique of the ved poets. aiming to make brahman perceptible.
pratyakṣādisaṃvāda [ādisaṃvāda] m. phil. epistemology based on perception etc.
pratyag iic. pratyac.
pratyagātman [ātman] m. phil. [Vedānta] the individual soul; the self; the individual.
pratyagjyotis [jyotis] n. phil. the inner light.
pratyagni [pratiagni] adv. towards the fire; in front of the fire.
pratyagra [pratiagra] amnf pratyagrā fresh, recent, new, young; pure. pratyagram recently. pratyagraiḥ kuṭajakusumaiḥ [MD.] with freshly picked jasmine flowers.

pratyac var. pratyañc [pratiac] amnf

pratīcī [m. nom. pratyan; n. nom. pratyak] turned towards the back; turned inwards | turned towards the West; western; to the west of (abl.) — f. pratīcī the West, the direction of the west. pratyak adv. back; inwards; to the west.
pratyadhva | pratiadhvan | mr. way back.

pratyanta [pratianta] amnf pratyantā neighbor, contiguous, adjacent — m. border, edge border region, march.
pratyantajanapada [janapada] n. population of the markets | pl. barbarian tribes.

pratyabhighṛ [pratiabhighṛ] ca. (Pra tyabhighārayati) to sprinkle repeatedly.

pratyabhijna₁ [pratiabhijna₁] v. [9] pr. (pratyabhijānāti) pr. r. (pratyabhijānīte) pp. (Pra tyabhijñāta) to recognize, to remember; to see, to understand | to regain one's senses, to regain consciousness — ca. (pratyabhijñāpayati) to recall.

Pratyabhijñā₂ [act. Pratyabhijñā₁] f. act of recognizing | [īśvarapratyabhijñā] phil. [Trika] np. of the Pratyabhijñā "recognition (of one's own identity with the Lord)", doctrine recognizing the identity of the individual soul and the Universal Soul, developed by Utpaladeva and Abhina vagupta; it affirms the reality of the World and transcends the opposition between dualism | dvaita | and monism [advaita] — m. pratyabhijña ifc. recognition of (iic.).

pratyabhijñādarśana [darśana] n. phil. philosophical system of recognition (of the Lord) [Pratyabhijñā], taught by the Trika school of Kashmira Shaivism; it was developed notably by Vasugupta, Somānanda, Utpaladeva, Abhinava gupta and Kṣemarāja; its aim is for Jīva to identify with Shiva.
pratyabhijñāśāstra [śāstra] n. phil. science of recognition, developed in Kaśmīra in the 9th century; cf. pratyabhijñādarśana.
pratyabhijñāhṛdaya [hṛdaya] n. bed. n.p. from Pratyabhijñāhrdaya “Essence of Self-recognition”, compendium of pratyabhijñāśāstra due to Kşemarāja.
pratyabhijñāta [pp. Pratyabhijñā₁] amnf pratyabhijñātā known, recognized.
pratyabhivāda [pratiabhivāda] m. soc. act of returning a greeting; out of respect, one lengthens [pluta] the last vowel of the name of a person whose greeting one returns.

pratyaya [act. pratī₂] m. belief, conviction, faith, confidence in g.; opinion | assurance, proof; certificate; knowledge, experience | reason, cause, motive | phil. cognition, understanding | bd. [Abhidharma] cause, means, support; effica causal [paccaya], of which there are 24 grammatical modes. derived word, ending, suffix; inflection; not. strīpratyaya, feminine stem-forming suffix; suppratyaya, nominal inflection suffix; tinpratyaya, verbal inflection suffix; purușapratyaya, conjugation suffix indicating person; kṛtpratyaya, primary nominal-forming suffix; taddhitapratyaya, secondary nominal-forming suffix | pali paccaya. pratyayam gam to acquire confidence in (acc.). tvadvācanapratyayāt on the faith of your word. mūdhah parapratyayaneyabuddhih a fool whose mind is influenced by the opinions of others.
pratyayādhikāra [adhikāra] m. gram. semantic relation expressed by a suffix taddhita.
pratyayānta [anta] m. gram. form produced by a pratyaya suffix; nominal or verbal theme; cf. kṛdanta, taddhitānta; inflected nominal or verbal form; cf. subanta, tinanta.
pratyayārtha [artha] m. gram. meaning of a suffix.
pratyayāśrita [āśrita] n. lit. the choice of suffixes, a literary device [alamkāra].
pratyayin [in] amnf pratyayinī which inspires confidence.
pratyarth [pratiarth] v. [10] pr. (pratyar thayati) pp. (pratyarthita) to challenge (in combat).
pratyartham [pratiartha] adv. in all cases, for each object.
pratyarthin [agt. pratyarth] amnf Pra tyarthinī hostile — ifc. that opposes, that confronts (iic.) — m. adversary, opponent; rival | soc. (law) accused, indicted.
pratyarp [pratiṛ] ca. (pratyarpayati) pp. (pratyarpita) to send back, return; to give back; to put back.
pratyarpita [pp. pratyarp] amnf pra tyarpitā returned; handed over.
pratyavamarśa [pratyavamṛś] m. reflection; contemplation, meditation; phil. consciousness. power of cognitive discrimination.
pratyavamṛś [pratiavamṛś] v. [1] pr. (pratyavamṛśati) to reflect, contemplate, meditate.

pratyavaruh [pratiavaruh] v. [1] pr. (pra tyavarohati) to descend again; to descend from (abl.) (in honor of (acc.)) | to celebrate the festival of pratyavarohana — ca. (pratyavaropayati) to cause to descend; to deprive of (abl. i.).
pratyavarohá [act. pratyavaruh] m. act of descending | descending series.
