pratyavarohaṇīya [īya] m. soc. solemn ceremony during the vājapeya where the king swears never to bow down before anyone.
pratyavāya [act. ave] m. decrease; reduction | backwards; opposite | annoyance; unpleasantness | offense; sin.
pratyavīkṣaṇa [pratiavīkṣaṇa] n. direct observation.
pratyave [pratiave] v. [2] pr. (pratyavati) pp. (pratyaveta) go back down | offend; sin.
pratyah [pratiah] pft. (pratyāha) (present) to say something to someone | to answer.
pratyaha [pratiaha₂] amnf pratyahā quo tidien.
pratyaham [pratiahan] adv. every day, daily.
pratyākhyā [pratiākhyā₁] v. [2] pr. (pratyākhyāti) pp. (pratyākhyāta) to refuse, reject, repudiate; to deny.
pratyākhyāna [act. pratyākhyā] n. refusal, denial, repudiation | soc. vow of asceticism, renunciation.
pratyāgam [pratiāgam] v. [1] pr. (pratyāgaccati) pp. (pratyāgata) to return.
pratyācakṣ [pratiācakṣ] v. [2] pr. r. (pratyācaṣṭe) to repel, reject; to refuse.
pratyādiś [pratiādiś] v. [1] pr. (pratyādiśati) pp. (pratyādiṣṭa) to order, to prescribe, to repel, to set aside, to repudiate.
pratyādiṣṭa [pp. pratyādiś] amnf pratyādiṣṭā ordered, prescribed | rejected, repudiated.

pratyādeśa [act. pratyādiś] m. rejection, refusal; setting aside, repudiation | the act of surpassing, belittling, shameful | that which brings shame (left). Urvaśī pratyādeśaḥ śriyaḥ Urvaśī screens Srī.
pratyāpanna | pratiāpanna| amnf pratyāpannā returned, gone back. pratyāpannacetana cetana amfn pratyāpannacetanā who has regained his senses.
pratyābhū [pratiābhū₁] v. [1] pr. (pratyābhavati) to be within reach; to be at the command of.
pratyāy [ca. pratī₂] v. [10] pr. (pratyāyayati) pp. (pratyāyita) to convince, to make believe.
pratyāya [act. pratī₂] m. tax, tribute.
pratyāyaka [agt. ca. pratī₂] amnf pratyāyikā which makes one understand; convincing, credible.
pratyāyana [agt. ca. pratī₂] amnf pratyāyanī that makes one understand; convincing, credible — act. n. explanation, demonstration — f. pratyāyanā persuasion.
pratyāyita [pp. ca. pratī₂] amnf pratyāyitā ifc. convinced of; who trusts — m. person of trust.
pratyāyya [pfp. [1] ca. pratī₂] amnf pratyāyyā to encourage; to support.
pratyārya [pratiārya] m. lit. verse in response to a verse ārya .
pratyālīḍha [pratiālīḍha] amnf pratyālīḍhā mangé — n. shooting position with the left knee forward, the right leg pulled back; opp. ālīḍha.
pratyāvṛt [pratiāvṛt₁] v. [1] pr. r. (pratyāvartate) pp. (pratyāvrtta) to turn around, to come back — ca. (pratyāvartayati) to push back.
pratyāvṛtta [pp. pratyāvṛt] amnf pratyāvṛttā returned; turned towards (face) | come back; back | repeated.
pratyāvṛtti [act. pratyāvṛt] f. return.
pratyāśā [pratiāśā₂] f. confidence, hope; expectation, expectation.
pratyāśin [in] amnf pratyāśinī who hopes, who expects; confident.
pratyāśvas [pratiāśvas] v. [2] pr. (pratāśvasiti) to catch one's breath; to regain courage; to revive.
pratyāśvasta | pratyāśvasta| amnf pratyāśvastā refreshed, regenerated, comforted.
pratyāśvāsa [act. pratyāśvas] m. act of catching one's breath | recovery; comfort.
pratyāsatti [act. pratyāsad] f. vicinity,
proximity | gram. analogy | good humor; opp. āsatti.
pratyāsad [pratiāsad] v. [1] pr. (pratyāsīdati) to sit opposite, to sit towards (acc.).
pratyāsanna |pp. pratyāsad| amnf pratyāsannā near, neighbor (of (g. iic.)) | imminent — n. proximity, neighborhood.
pratyāsannatā |tā| f. proximity, neighborhood.

pratyāhāra [act. pratyāhṛ] m. act of re-drawing; withdrawal, abstraction; dissolution | phil. concentration by retraction of the senses, 5th stage of rājayoga; cf. astāngayoga | gram. ["selection by condensed statement"] abbreviation by a phoneme followed by a marker, designating a set of phonemes in the pratyāhārasūtrāni of Pānini.
pratyāhāramṛtyu [mṛtyu] amnf whose death is imminent.

pratyāhārasūtra |sūtra| n. pl. pratyāhārasūtrāņi mnemonic formula for composing sets of Sanskrit phonemes: aiun | rlk | eon | ai au c | ha ya va ra t | la n | ña ma na na na | jha bha ñ | gha dha dha s | ja ba ga da da ś | kha pha cha tha tha ca ta ta v | ka pa y | śa sa sa r | ha l | | ; the last consonants of each verse |pāda| are markers [anubandha]; a pratyāhāra comprises a beginning phoneme and a final marker; it names all intermediate phonemes, excluding markers; thus hal names all the consonants, ac the vowels, sar the sibi lantes, yan the semivowels, and al the whole alphabet; syn. śivasūtra, maheśvarasūtra.
pratyāhṛ [pratiāhṛ] v. [1] pr. (pratyāharati) pp. (pratyāhṛta) to bring back, to hand over; to take back.
pratyāhṛta [pp. pratyāhṛ] amnf pratyāhṛtā taken up, recaptured.
pratyukta [pp. prativac] amnf pratyuktā answered — n. answer.
pratyuta [pratiuta₁] adv. on the contrary; rather.
pratyutthā [pratiutthā] v. [1] pr. (pratyuttisthati) pp. (pratyutthita) to rise to welcome (acc.).
pratyutthāna [act. pratyutthā] n. soc. act of getting up to welcome a person.
pratyutpanna [pratiutpanna] amnf pratyutpannā present, ready.
pratyutpannabuddha | buddha | m. bd. buddha of the present time.
pratyutpannamati | mati| amnf quick-witted; attentive.
pratyutpannamatitva |tva| n. presence of mind.
pratyutsuka | pratiutsuka | amnf pra tyutsukā desiring.
pratyudāharaņa [act. udāhr] n. counterexample, refutation | gram. not. counterexample to a rule.
pratyudāhṛ [pratiudāhṛ] v. [1] pr. (pra tyudāharati) pp. (pratyudāhṛta) to answer; to give the answer | gram. to give a counterexample.
pratyudāhṛta [pp. pratyudāhṛ] amnf pratyudāhṛtā answered; refuted.
pratyupakāra [act. pratyupakṛ] m. act of returning a service; gratitude. pratyupakārārtham in recognition of services rendered.
pratyupakārin [agt. pratyupakṛ] amnf pratyupakāriņī who returns a service; recognizing.
pratyupakṛ |pratiupakṛ| v. [8] pr. r. (pra tyupakurute) return a service.
pratyupta [pp. prativap] amnf pratyuptā inserted in, inlaid in (loc.) — ifc. garnished with, decorated with (iic.).
pratyuṣa [pratiuṣas] m. dawn — n. pratyus id.
Pratyūṣa [pratyuṣa] m. dawn | myth. np. of Pratyūṣa the Sun, one of the 8 Treasures [vasu]. mahati pratyūse of early morning.
pratye [practice] v. [2] pr. (pratyaiti) pp. (pra tyeta) pf. (sat) to return, to return.
pratyeka [pratieka] amnf pratyekā each, individual, taken separately; in whole |bd. particular sin. pratyekam var. pratyekaśas adv. one by one, separately; for each.
pratyekabuddha [buddha] m. bd. [Jātakamālā] hermit buddha who obtains liberation for himself and not for others || pali paccekabuddha.
pratyenas [pratienas] m. auxiliary of justice; police officer, vigilante |soc. closest relative of a deceased person, guarantor of their debts and faults.

√ ਸਪ prath [related to prth] v. [1] pr. r. (prathate) pp. (prathita) to extend, increase, spread, become famous — ca. (prathayati) to extend, spread; to proclaim, make famous. tadākhyayā bhuvi paprathe var. tadākhyām jagāma he was known by this name. ਸਪ pratha [agt. prath] m. myth. np. from the ṛṣi Pra tha "Famous", son of Vasistha, supposed author of hymns of the Rigveda — f. prathā extension, dispersion; generalization; expansion, spreading, popularity, celebrity; celebration. prathām gam to become famous.

práthana [act. prath] n. extension; deployment; display | celebration. ਸ਼ਪਸ prathamá amnf prathamā ord. pre mier, initial, eldest, preceding; that which is at the head, the best | the oldest — acc. prathamam adv. previously, formerly; before; before (g.) | firstly; at first, the first time | at the first attempt, immediately | already — m. [prathamapuruṣa] gram. 3rd pers. (listed first in Sanskrit) — f. prathamā gram. nominative (1st case of declension) | gr. ; lat. primus; fr. premier. prathamatas adv. first. prathamaikavacanānta gram. (nominal form) in the nominative singular. prathamaganitamiva tavottaram your answer seems prepared in advance.
prathita [pp. prath] amnf prathitā extended | disclosed; published; known | famous, re-named; celebrated.
prathiti [act. prath] f. celebrity, notoriety.
prathimán [pṛthaiman] m. extension, ma gnitude, grandeur. ਸ਼ ਪਿষ práthistha [super. prathita] amnf prathisthā the most extensive, the widest.
práthīyas [compar. prathita] amnf prathīyasī more extensive, wider; very wide.
prada [agt. pradā] ifc. amnf pradā that gives, that grants (iic.). viśvāsaprada that gives confidence. sarvaprada that gives everything.

pradakṣiṇa [Pradakṣiṇa] amnf pradakṣiṇā to the right; opp. prasavya | dextrogyre | turned towards someone or something placed to their right; respectful | towards the South — mnf pradakṣiṇā soc. circumambulation of a temple (clockwise, leaving the shrine on the right) — v. [11] pr. (pradakṣiṇayati) to circumambulate. pradaksinam adv. to the right. pradaksinam kr to turn clockwise (as a sign of respect, around a shrine or a person). yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntarakṛtāni ca | tāni tāni vinašyanti pradakṣiṇapade pade | (prayer spoken during circumambulation) all the sins of previous lives, all their benefits too, all will be erased, while step by step we circumambulate.
pradakṣiṇakriyā [kriyā] f. action of circling around a person as a sign of respect. pradakṣiṇakriyārha worthy of receiving the homage of pradaksina.
pradakṣiṇapatha | patha | m. processional path around the sanctuary of a temple, ambulatory.
pradatta var. pratta [pp. pradā] amnf pradattā given, offered, granted (not. in marriage).
pradarśa [act. pradṛś] m. aspect; appearance.
pradarśana [act. pradṛś] n. appearance; appearance | gram. illustrative statement — f. pradarśanā ifc. aspect of (iic.) — f. pradarśanā indication | pradarśanī exhibition.
pradarśin [agt. pradṛś] ifc. amnf Pra darśinī which indicates, which shows (iic.).
pradava |agt. pradu| amnf pradavā which burns.
pradā [Pradā₁] v. [3] pr. (pradadāti) pp. (Pra datta, pratta) pf. (prati, sam) to offer, to grant; to entrust | to impart (knowledge).
pradātṛ [agt. pradā] amnf pradātrī ifc. who gives, who grants — m. soc. father who gives his daughter in marriage.
pradāna |act. pradā| n. gift, offering, present; liberality | soc. presentation of an oblation in the sacrificial fire | soc. act of giving in marriage teaching, communication of knowledge.
pradāya |act. prada | n. gift.
pradāyaka [agt. pradā] amnf pradāyikā that gives, that grants (g. iic.).
pradāyin [agt. pradā] amnf pradāyinī who gives, who grants (g. iic.)
pradi [act. pradā] f. Don; gift.
pradigdha [pp. pradih] amnf pradigdhā coated, anointed; soiled; covered with (i. iic.). rudhirapradigdha amn soiled by blood.
pradiś₁ [Pradiś₁] v. [1] pr. (pradiśati) pp. (pradista) to show, to indicate | to prescribe, to order; to determine — ca. (pradeśayati) to exhort, to excite.
pradiś₂ [obj. pradiś₁] f. direction, region of the sky.
pradisas [sas] adv. in all directions, everywhere.
pradiṣṭa [pp. pradiś₂] amnf pradiṣṭā in diqué; determined; ordered.
pradih [pradih] v. [2] pr. (pradegdhi) pp. (pradigdha) to coat, anoint.
pradīp [pradīp] v. [4] pr. r. (pradīpyate) pp. (pradīpta) to burn, to blaze — ca. (pradīpayati) to light, to set on fire, to ignite.

pradīpa [agt. pradīp] m. lamp, lantern — ifc. Light of, glory of (iic.) | Light on, enlightenment of (iic.) | [Bhāṣyapradīpa] gram. np. of the pradīpa "Light on the gloss (of Patañjali₁)", due to Kaiyata; cf. Bhāṣyapradīpa.
pradīpoddyota [uddyota] m. gram. np. of the pradīpoddyota, commentary on the pradīpa due to Nāgeśa; cf. uddyota.
pradīpaka [agt. pradīp] amnf pradīpikā that illuminates — m. small lamp — f. pradīpikā lit. (in fig.) illumination; title of exegetical works.
pradīpta [pp. pradīp] amnf pradīptā al lumé, burning.
pradu | pradu | ps. (pradūyate) to be consumed by flames — v. [5] pr. (pradunoti) to oppress, to lie.

praduṣ [praduṣ] v. [4] pr. (praduṣyati) pp. (praduṣṭa) to deteriorate, worsen; to be bad, corrupt, impure | to sin, commit a fault, fall; lose faith — ca. (pradūṣayati) to spoil, corrupt, pollute. সব্তুম praduṣṭa [pp. praduṣļ amnf praduṣṭā corrupt, bad, vicious — f. pradustā soc. sinful woman; unfaithful woman. সহুষ্ pradṛś [pradṛś₁] ps. (pradṛśyate) to become visible, appear; to expose oneself — ca. (pradarśayati) to show, to display; to indicate, to explain, to describe.
pradeśa [obj. pradiś₁] m. example | region, country; place, spot — iic. short duration.
pradeṣṭṛ [agt. pradiś₁] amnf pradeṣṭṛī judge; royal inspector.
pradeha [obj. pradih] plaster; ointment; poultice — act. n. the act of applying an ointment or coating a plaster.

pradoṣa₁ [pradoṣa₁] m. twilight, beginning of night | soc. period favorable to Shiva, from 3 a.m. before to 3 a.m. after sunset, on the 13th day of each lunar fortnight [pakṣa]. pradoșam var. pradoșe at nightfall, in the dark.
pradoṣa₁ [pradoṣa₂] amnf pradoṣā mau vais, vicieux, corrupt — m. fault; defect; mala die; disorder, rebellion, mutiny.
pradauhitra [pradauhitra] m. great-grandson (son of a granddaughter) — f. pradauhitrī daughter of a granddaughter.
pradyut [pradyut₁] ca. (pradyotayati) to illuminate, to envelop in Light.

Pradyumna | Pradyumna | m. myth. np. of Pradyumna "the Glorious," epithet of Kama; he was reborn as the son of Krishna and Rukmiṇī; a prophecy said that he would be killed by the demon Sambara₁; he was stolen as a child by Sambara₁, thrown into the sea, and found in the belly of a fish; he was raised by Mayavati, whom he married; their son is Aniruddha; phil. [pañcarātra] he is deified as
aspect | vyūha | of VāsudevaViṣṇu; in the spiritual heaven it is the direction of the South || pkt. Pajjunna.

pradyotá [agt. pradyut] m. Light, radiance | hist. np. of the Pradyota₁ dynasty, which reigned in Avanti in the 7th century BC; |Vāyupurāṇa| its kings annexed Magadha and conquered Kauśāmbī; King Siśunāga ended it in 413 BC. hist. np. of King Pradyota₁ Mahāsena of Avanti; he reigned in Ujjayinī in the 5th century BC; [KSS.] cf. Caṇḍamahāsena | lit. [KSS.] title of the king of Magadha in the time of Udayana; Padmāvatī₂ is his daughter | myth. [Bhavisyapurāṇa] np. of King Pradyota₁ of Hastināpura, son of Kṣemaka, killed by barbarians; for the repose of his father, Nārada incited him to make a great massacre of foreigners |mlecchayajña|; he reigned 10000 years, then his son Vedavān reigned 2000 years.
pradrāva | act. pradru| m. act of running away; flight.
pradrāvin [agt. pradru] m. fugitive; fugitive.
pradru [pradru₁] v. [1] pr. (pradravati) pp. (pradruta) ["to run forward"] to save oneself, to flee; to rush towards (acc.) — ca. (pradrāvayati) to put to flight.
pradruta [pp. pradru] amnf pradrutā en fugi.
pradvis [pradvis₁] v. [2] pr. (pradvésti) pr. r. (pradvisté) pp. (pradvista) to hate, to detest; to find repugnant.
pradvesa [act. pradvis] m. adversion, disgust, repugnance; hatred — f. pradveṣī myth. np. of Pradvesī "Repulsion", wife of Dīrghatamā, mother not. of Gautama.
pradhána [pradhana] n. booty; prize won by a victory | precious possessions, treasure.
pradham [pradham] v. [1] pr. (pradhamati) pp. (pradhmāta) to blow (not. into a conch shell acc.). ŧ0 śańkhān pradadhmuḥ they blew into their conch shells.

negation [abhāva] as the absence of something before its creation.

Prapañcabuddhi [buddhi] m. lit. [KSS.] np. of the beggar Prapañcabuddhi "with the deceitful mind"; he deceived King Vikramāditya by bringing him jewels, and soliciting his help to perform a rite enabling him to acquire magical powers, by his sacrifice; warned in a dream, the king deceived him, killed him, and acquired in his place from Kubera the power to move through the air, and five self-regenerating magical gold statues.
prapañcasāra |sāra| m. lit. np. from prapañcasāra "Essence of the visible world", esoteric text [Tantra] attributed to Sankara₁ but later.
prapañcopaśama [upaśama] m. phil. [Gaudapāda] cessation of the manifestation of the world.
prapaṇa [prapaṇa] m. exchange; barter.

prapat [prapat₁] v. [1] pr. (prapatati) pp. (prapatita) to fly away; to hasten towards, to fall upon (loc.) | to fall; to be deprived of, to lose (abl.) — ca. (prapātayati) to make fly away; to chase; to make fall — des. (prapipatisati) to desire to save oneself — intens. (prapāpatīti) to throw.

prápatha [prapatha] m. journey — f. prapathā highway — amnf prapathā ready to go.
prapathin |in| amnf prapathin great traveler.

(prapadyate) pp. (prapanna) to fall from (abl.); to throw oneself (at the feet [pādau] of (acc.) | to go towards, to go to | to seek refuge or help from (acc.) | to obtain, to enjoy; to undertake, to succeed. vidyām prapad to attain knowledge. śaranam prapad to seek refuge from (acc.). bahūnām janmanām ante jñānavān mām prapa
dyate [BhG.] It is only after many rebirths that one manages to know me.

prapada | prapada | n. toe. ਸ਼ਾਸ prapanna [pp. prapad] amnf prapannā arrived, came, appeared; endowed with, endowed with (i.). śaraṇam prapannaḥ who has placed himself under the protection of. pādau prapannah fallen at the feet of.

prapaśyat [ppr. prapaś] amnf prapaśyantī judicious, reasonable; intelligent.
prapā₁ [prapā₁] v. [1] pr. (prapibati) to start drinking; to soak; to feast. cakṣuṣā prapā₁ to feast at a spectacle.
prapā₁ [instr. prapā₁] f. place for drinking; well, cistern, reservoir.
prapāṭha | prapāṭha | m. | "reading" | chapter of a book.

book [kāṇḍa] of the Satapatha brāhmaṇa; it is composed of chapters | brāhmaṇa |

prapīti [act. prapā₁] f. act of drinking — ins. f. receptacle for beverage.

prapuṇya [prapuṇya] n. grace; blessing; mercy. suvakṣojakumbhāṃ sudhāpūrṇakumbhāṃ prapuņyāvalambām prasādāvalambām sadāsyendubimbām sadānaoṣṭhabimbām bhaje śāradāmbāmajasram madambām || [Sāradābhujamga] You with the lovely breast like a jar, You who are the inexhaustible jar of nectar, You who bring down divine grace, You who bring down mercy, whose face is forever the image of the disk of the Moon, whose generous lips have the purple of the bimba fruit, I adore you, Goddess Śāradā, eternally my Mother.
prapautra [prapautra] m. great-grandson (son of a grandson) — f. prapautrī daughter of a grandson.
praphulta [praphulla] amnf praphultā in bloom — f. praphulti flowering. ਸ਼ਾਲ਼ praphulla [praphulla] amnf praphulla in bloom, covered in flowers | in full bloom, wide open; smiling, jovial, happy.
prabaddha [pp. prabandh] amnf pra baddhā bound, tied; chained | stopped, hindered, prevented — ifc. which depends on (iic.). ^12
prabandh [prabandh] v. [9] pr. (prabadhnāti) v. [9] pr. r. (prabadhnīté) pp. (prabaddha) to bind, to stain; chain.

prabandhārtha | artha | m. lit. meaning of a literary work. সৰল prabala [prabala] amnf prabalā strong, then sant, important; violent (pain) — ifc. abundant in (iic.). prabalībhū to strengthen, to acquire power.
prabalatā [tā] f. force, power.
prabalatva [tva] n. force, power.

prabodha [act. ca. prabudh] m. awakening (from sleep or ignorance); awareness | knowledge, understanding, intelligence | phil. Awakening. aprabodhāya sā suṣvāpa she fell asleep never to wake up again.

prabodhacandrodaya [candrodaya] m. lit. np. from prabodhacandrodaya "Moonrise of knowledge", an allegorical drama in 6 acts by Kṛṣṇamiśra (11th century); it teaches the Vaishnava version of monism [advaita] by staging abstract feelings.

prabodhaka [agt. ca. prabudh] amnf prabodhikā that awakens; that makes bloom | soc. servant charged with waking the king — m. ifc. understanding, intelligence of. sukhaprabodhaka very understandable.

prabodhana [agt. ca. prabudh] amnf prabodhanī that awakens, that stimulates — act. n. awakening |understanding; knowledge — f. prabodhanī soc. festival celebrating the awakening of Vișnu, on the 11th day of the clear fortnight of the month kārttika.

prabodhin [agt. ca. prabudh] amnf prabod hinī that awakens; that announces, that reveals | emanating from (abl.) — f. prabodhinī revelation; ifc. title of didactic works. hastinādaprabodhinī f. (the Goddess) announced by the noise of her elephants.
prabodhya [pfp. [1] ca. prabudh] amnf prabodhyā that one must awaken. সরু prabrū [prabrū] v. [2] pr. (prabravīti) pr. r. (prabrūté) pf. (prati) to explain, to teach; to announce; to call, to name.

Prabhava |agt. prabhū| mr. origin | astr. n.p. of Prabhava "Beginning", son of Nāradī personifying year 1 of a life cycle.

(prabhāti) pp. (prabhāta) to shine, to gleam, to illuminate; to appear, to seem. ਸਮਾ Prabhā₂ |act. Prabhā₁| f. Light, splendor, radiance | myth. np. of Prabhā "Light", epith. of Durgā | [prabhāvali] circle of flames surrounding an image (not. Cola bronzes).

Prabhākara₁ [kara₁] m. luminary; the Sun; the Moon myth. class of deities, the beings of Light phil. np. of Prabhākara₁ Miśra, 7th-century Mīmāmsaka philosopher, student of Kumārila; he professed that there are no errors of perception, only inaccuracies; unlike Kumārila, he denied the principle of non-existence by absence [abhāva], following Dharmakīrti in this; he recognized languages

foreign languages [mleccha] as not derived from Sanskrit and encouraged bilingualism [dvaibhāṣika]; he is the author of the Bṛhatī | hist. np. of King Prabhākara₁; general of the Pusyabhūti family, he [3] founded the Vardhana₁ dynasty of North India in the 6th century; its capital was Sthāneśvara; upon his death in 605, his eldest son Rājya succeeded him, then his younger son Harşa ascended the throne at 16 to found an empire | hist. np. of Prabhākara₁, brother of Ratnākara₃, guru of Maharāja Jayasimha₆ of Amber (18th century). Prabhākara the Sun and the Moon.
prabhākarabhaṭṭa |bhaṭṭa| mr. hist. n.p. by prabhākarabhaṭṭa, author of Rasapradīpa (16th century).
prabhākaravardhana | vardhana | mr. hist. n.p. of king prabhākaravardhana, father of Harṣa; cf. Prabhākara₁.
Prabhācandra [Candra] m. hist. np. of the Jain logician Prabhācandra (980–1065), author of the Pra meyakamalamārtanda.

prabhāta |pp. prabhā₁| amnf prabhātā appeared; which became clear — n. dawn, morning. prabhāte adv. at dawn, in the morning. tasyākṣṇoḥ prabhātamāsīt the day dawned before his eyes.
prabhāna [agt. prabhā₁] n. Light, radiance, brightness.

prabhānīya [pfp. [2] prabhā₁] amnf prabhānīyā which must be illuminated. ਸਮਾਰ prabhāva [act. prabhū] m. power, strength, might; majesty, dignity; splendor | faculty; efficacy; impact. prabhāvāt var. prabhāveņa, prabhāvatas by means of; because of, as a consequence of (g. iic.); par. jalasya prabhāveņa vṛkṣā rohanti trees grow thanks to the rain.

prabhāvatī [f. prabhāvat] f. "Brilliant", np. of many deities | lit. np. of prabhāvatī, heroine of the framing narrative of the Sukasaptati; whenever she wants to join a lover, the parrot tells her a story to lull her to sleep | lit. [KSS.] np. of the vidyādharī prabhāvatī₁, daughter of King Pingalagāndhāra; thanks to her magical powers, she helped Naravāhanadatta find Ma danamañcukā, while marrying her along the way; then she disappeared, leaving her appearance behind, allowing her to appear as a woman in the gynaeceum of her brother Mānasavega; When this power ceased, Mānasavega had Naravāhanadatta arrested, but Vāyupatha, aided by Šiva counterfeited by prabhāvatī₁, made him escape.
prabhāṣ [Prabhāṣ] v. [1] pr. r. (prabhāṣate) pf. (sam) to say, declare, explain | to say to acc. .
prabhās [Prabhās₁] v. [1] pr. r. (prabhāsate) to shine, to gleam; to appear, to seem — ca. (prabhāsayati) to light up, to illuminate.

prabhāsa [agt. prabhās] m. splendor, beauty myth. n.p. of prabhāsa the Light, one of the 8 Treasures [vasu] | bed. [KSS.] np. of prabhāsa₁, general of Sūryaprabha — b. geo. n.p. of the tīrtha prabhāsa₂, an important place of pilgrimage on the Gujarat coast, near Dvārakā; cf. prabhāsakṣetra.
prabhāsakṣetra [kṣetra] n. geo. n.p. from the prabhāsakṣetra "Place of Light", Place of pilgrimage [tīrtha] on the coast of Gujarat, near Dvārakā; cf. Prabhāsapattana.
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya | māhātmya | n. bed. n.p. of prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, 1st section of Prabhāsakhanda.
prabhāsakhaṇḍa [khaṇḍa] mn lit. n.p. of Prabhāsakhanda, section of Skandapurāņa.

Prabhāsapattana [pattana] n. geo. np. of the tīrtha Prabhāsapattana, Place of pilgrimage of the Gurjara, near Somanāthapattana; myth. it was here that Candra prayed to Siva to deliver him from the curse of Dakșa; it was also here that Kṛṣṇa was cremated, after being mortally wounded in the heel by the arrow of the hunter Jarā₂; the son of Sāndīpani had drowned there, captured by the demon Pañcajana.

prabhāsavaracitta [citta] n. bd. state of clear consciousness, manifested as luminosity.
prabhid [Prabhid₁] v. [7] pr. (prabhinatti) pr. r. (prabhintte) pp. (prabhinna) to split.

prabhinnāñjana [añjana] n. grey eye drops. ਸ਼ਮੂ prabhú [agt. prabhū] amnf prabhū f. prabhvī strong, powerful, capable; rich, abundant | of the same caliber as, as strong as (abl.) — m. lord, master, king | myth. np. of Prabhu "lord", epith. of various gods, not. Vișnu or Shiva.

prabhutva |tva| n. state of sovereignty, supreme power | authority, power over (g. loc. iic.)

prabhúśabdaśesa [śabdaśesa] amnf prabhuśabdaśeṣā king only in name. ਸਮ੍ਰ prabhū [prabhū₁] v. [1] pr. (prabhavati) pp. (prabhūta) to come from, to arise from, to originate from (abl.) | to appear, to become visible | to increase, to become strong; to be powerful, to command, to control; to dominate, to be master of (g. loc. dat.), to prevail over abl. | to be capable of dat. loc. inf. . himavato gangā prabhavati the Ganges emanates from the Himalayas. guruh praharsah prababhūva nātmani He could not suppress his great joy. katham mrtyuh prabhavati vedaśāstravidām |Manu| How could death prevail over those who know the Veda and the treatises?

prábhūta [pp. prabhū] amnf prabhūtā produced, appeared; transformed into (iic.) | numerous, rich, abundant, great | capable of (inf.) — iic. many, full of, rich in (ifc.) | pl. prabhūtās several, many. prabhūtabalih soc. ceremony of offerings performed on the 10th day after a death, marking the final separation of the soul of the deceased from his family.

prabhūtatva [tva] n. abundance; multitude | in sufficiency.
prabhūtavayas | vayas₁ | amnf of advanced age; aged.

prabhṛti [act. prabhṛ] f. beginning — mn beginning with, from, after (abl. ii.); syn. ādi — adv. after (abl. ii.); etc. adya prabhrti adv. from today. tatprabhṛti adv. henceforth. tatah prabhrti adv. from that moment; henceforth. tadā prabhṛti id. urahprabhrti gram. Pan (I. 4 . 74): (are also considered as gati) sākṣāt and his successors (in the gaṇapāṭha).
prabheda [act. prabhid] m. action of splitting, cutting.
prabhraṃś [prabhraṃś] v. [1] pr. r. (prabhramsate) pp. (prabhrasta) to fall, slip, disappear. ਸਮਣ prabhraṣṭa [pp. prabhraṃś] amnf prabhraṣṭā fallen, fled from (abl.).

prámati [act. praman] f. protection, provi dence — m. myth. np. of the hermit Pramati₁ "Protector", son of Cyavana and Sukanyā, father of Ruru by Pratāpī | lit. [DKC.] np. of the young Pramati₁ "Providence", son of Kāmapāla, one of the 10 heroes of the Daśakumāracarita; lost in the forest he fell asleep only to wake up in a bed with a beauty; then he saw an emaciated woman who told him that she was his mother the yakṣī Tārāvalī; he married the princess Navamālikā.

pramatha [agt. pramanth] m. myth. class of tormenting demons, servants of Shiva | myth. np. of pramatha "Tormentor", son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.
pramathaprathama [prathama] m. myth. "first among the servants of Shiva", epith. of Nandī.
pramathana [agt. pramanth] amnf pra mathanī that torments, that mistreats; that destroys — act. n. pramathana agitation, churning; dom mage, destruction.

pramad₁ [pramad₁] v. [4] pr. (pramādyati) pp. (pramatta) to be joyful, to take pleasure | to be indifferent to (abl. loc.), to be negligent towards (loc.); to treat lightly, to neglect (abl.); to waste one's time; to let oneself go, to give in to (loc.); to give in to illusion.
pramád₂ |obj. pramad₁| f. desire; lust.

pramadvara | vara₂ | amnf Pramadvarā careless, imprudent — f. Pramadvarā myth. [Mah.] np. of the pretty nymph Pramadvarā, daughter of Me nakā and Viśvāvasu; she married the wise Ruru, who saved her life after her bite with a venomous snake, and by whom she bore Sunaka.
pramada |agt. pramad₁| amnf carefree pramadā; libertine, dissolute — m. joy, pleasure — f. cf. pramadā.
pramadā [f. pramada] f. frivolous woman or woman of loose morals; young woman — v. [11] pr. (pra madāyati) to behave like a loose woman.
pramadājana [jana] m. female gender, women.

pramaditavya [pfp. [3] pramad₁] amnf pramaditavyā to neglect, to treat lightly — n. (impers.) one must neglect (abl.). na pramaditavyam there must be no negligence towards (abl.); one must not deviate from abl. . satyānna pramaditavyam | dharmānna pramadita vyam | kuśalānna pramaditavyam | bhūtyā na pra maditavyam | svādhyāyapravacanābhyām na pra maditavyam | [TU.] One must not deviate from the truth, one must not deviate from one's duty, one must not neglect one's health, one must not fall from one's station, one must not neglect the study and transmission of sacred texts. devapitṛkāryābhyām na pramaditavyam |TU.| We must not neglect the rites towards the gods and the spirits.
praman [praman] pr. r. (pramante) to think.
pramanth var. pramath [pramanth] v. [1] pr. (pramanthati) pp. (pramathita) to use violence, mistreat, torment — ca. (pramāthayati) attack, molest, violate.
pramantha [agt. pramanth] m. upper part of a fire stick; syn. uttarāraņi.

pramā₁ [pramā₁] v. [3] pr. r. (pramimīte) v. [2] pr. (pramāti) pp. (pramīta) to measure, estimate; for mer, create, arrange | to know, to form an exact idea of | phil. [Nyāya] to know from; [mīmāṃsā] to form a knowledge of — ps. (pramīyate) to be measured.
pramā₁ [obj. pramā₁] f. foundation | measure; scale; standard | phil. correct knowledge; valid knowledge.
Pramācintāmaṇi [cintāmaṇi] m. bed. np of the Pramācintāmaņi of Gangesa; cf. Tattvacintāmaņi.
pramātmaka [ātmaka] amnf pramātmikā phil. characterizes valid [jñāna] cognition; opp. bh ramātmaka.

pramāna [act. pramā₁] n. measure, size, capacity, length, width, mass, duration | standard, model, norm; authority, rule; proof, evidence phil. legitimate means of knowledge; the Nyāya recognizes four, according to their instrument [karaṇa] of knowledge: direct observation by per
the conception [pratyakṣa] of the materialists [cārvākās]; the inference [anumāna] of the logicians, based on logical argumentation [tarka]; the identification by
analogy [upamāna]; and the knowledge induced by speech [śabdabodha], when that speech is

revealed [śruti] or transmitted by a trustworthy speaker [āptopadeśa]; the Vaiśeṣika recognizes only the first two; the Mīmāmsā adds refutation [abhāva], which posits that what we cannot know does not exist | phil. [Mīmāmsā] instrument of right knowledge | phil. [Yoga] valid judgment, a cognitive process [cittavṛtti] | phil. sense of proportion, an aesthetic feeling [sadangaśilpa] — f. pramāṇā ifc. magnitude of, measure of (iic.). pramāṇīkṛ to take as authority; to appeal to. pramāṇam bhavān be judge. devah pramāṇam it is for the king to decide. I appeal to Your Honor regarding this matter. [Prabhākara] All perception is legitimate knowledge. [Patanjali₁] What speech says is our means of knowledge. [Vātsyāyana₂] One cannot know the object without an adequate means of knowledge; without knowledge of the object there is no effective action.
pramāṇatā [tā] f. phil. authority; insurance.
pramāṇatva [tva] n. id.
pramāṇapaddhati [paddhati] f. bed. n.p. from the pramāṇapaddhati “Path of right knowledge”, philosophical work. by Jayatīrtha, commentary on the Pramānalakṣaṇa.
pramāṇapradhāna [pradhāna] amnf pramāṇapradhānā of an epistemological nature.
pramānabhūta [bhūta] amnf pramānabhūtā which is authoritative.
Pramāṇayuktinidhi [yuktinidhi] m. lit. np. of the Pramāṇayuktinidhi "Treasury of Logic and True Perceptions", by Saskya Pandita (1182–1251), commenting on Dharmakīrti, originally written in Tibetan.
pramāṇalakṣaṇa [lakṣaṇa] n. bed. n.p. from the pramāṇalakṣaṇa “Sign of right knowledge”, a work of epistemology by Madhya.
pramāṇavāda [vāda] m. phil. epistemological doctrine.
pramāṇavādin [in] amnf pramāṇavādinī phil. epistemologist.
pramānavārttika [vārttika] n. bed. from np. Pramāṇavārttika "Commentary on Right Knowledge", work of Dharmakīrti; cf. Pramanasiddhi.
Pramāṇavārttikasvavṛtti [svavṛtti] f. bed. n.p. of the Pramāṇavārttikasvavṛtti, self-Commentary by Dharmakīrti of the preceding.
pramāṇavārttikālaṃkāra [alaṃkāra] m. bed. n.p. from Prajñākaragupta's Pramānavārttikālamkāra.
pramāṇavārttikālaṃkāraṭīkā [ṭīkā] f. bed. n.p. from the Pramāṇavārttikālaṃkāraṭīkā Supariśuddhā of Yamāri (11th century).
pramāṇavārttikālamkārabhāṣya [bhāṣya] n. bed. n.p. from the pramā₂ņavārttikālamkarabhāsya of Prajñākaragupta; he discusses the relationship between the Buddha's omniscience and his authority.
pramāṇaviniścaya [viniścaya] m. bed. n.p. of pramāṇaviniścaya, epistemological work of Dharmakīrti.
pramāṇaviṣayatva [viṣayatva] n. phil. which is knowledge.
Pramāṇasamuccaya |samuccaya| mr. bed. n.p. from the Pramāṇasamuccaya "Compilation of sources of knowledge", work of phil. bd. Dinnāga; he discusses the doctrine of anyāpoha.
pramāṇasamuccayaṭīkā [ṭīkā] f. bed. n.p. by pramāṇasamuccayaṭīkā, Commentary on the previous one by Jinendrabuddhi.
pramānasiddhi [siddhi] f. bed. n.p. of the pramāṇasiddhi, chapter of the Pramāṇavārttika.
pramāṇaka [agt. pramā₂] amnf pramāṇikā ifc. measure of, proof of (iic.) — f. pramāṇikā phon. variety of meter anuṣṭubh₂.
pramāṇī iiv. pramāṇa.
pramāṇīkaraṇa | karaṇa | n. instrument of proof; reference to an authority.
pramāṇīkṛta |kṛta| amnf pramāṇīkṛtā me suré à l'aune de (g.) | considered as authority; in accordance with | considered as proof.
pramāṇībhūta [bhūta] amnf pramāṇībhūtā considered as authority or proof.
pramātāmaha |pramātāmaha| m. maternal great-grandfather — f. pramatāmahī maternal great-grandmother.
pramātṛ [agt. pramā₂] amnf pramātrī that perceives — m. phil. the being that perceives: opp. jñātṛ phil. [Nyāya] agent of right knowledge.
pramāth [ca. pramanth] v. [10] pr. (pramāthayati) pp. (pramāthita) attack, molest, violate.
pramātha [act. pramāth] m. violence exerted, act of assaulting, molesting; destruction; abduction, kidnapping (of a woman).
pramāthita [pp. pramāth] amnf pramāthitā violated, molested.

pramāthin [agt. pramāth] amnf pramāthinī who uses violence, Carried away — m. astr. n.p. of Pramāthī "Carried away", personifying the 13th year of a life cycle [samvatsara] — ifc. of the creators of (iic.).
pramāda |act. pramad₁| m. intoxication, delusion; error, illusion | negligence (of (abl. iic.)) | accident, misfortune. pramādo'pi dhīmatām Even the wise make mistakes.

pramādin [agt. pramad₁] amnf pramādinī negligent, careless; indifferent intoxicated, drunk; foolish — m. astr. np. of Pramādī "Neglected", son of Nāradī personifying the 47th year of a life cycle [samvatsara].
pramita [pp. pramā₂] amnf pramitā limited, moderate, small.
pramiti [act. pramā₂] f. manifestation | phil. [Nyāya] act of knowing, cognition — obj. f. phil. that which is known; knowledge.
pramī₂ [pramī] v. [9] pr. (pramīṇāti) v. [5] pr. (praminoti) pp. (pramīta) destroy, annihilate transgress; overcome, surpass.
pramī₂ [agt. pramī₂] ifc. amnf which surpasses (iic.).
vātapramī ["faster than the wind"] antelope; che val.
pramukha [pramukha] amnf pramukhī that faces (acc.); first, principal — ifc. that has as its head; preceded by (iic.) — n. beginning (of a chapter). pramukhatas adv. opposite (iic.); face to face.
bhīṣmadroṇapramukhatas [BhG.] before Bhīṣma and Drona.
pramuc [Pramuc₁] v. [6] pr. (pramuñcati) pp. (pramukta) pf. (vi) to free, to deliver; to deliver from (abl.) | to get rid of (g.); to escape from.
pramud₁ [Pramud₁] v. [1] pr. r. (pramodate) pp. (pramudita) to rejoice, to be Joyful — ca. (Pra modayati) rejoice.
pramud₁ |act. pramud₁| f. joy; Pleasure; Sensual pleasure.
pramudita [pp. pramud₁] amnf pramu ditā joyful; Joyful — n. joy; gaiety — f. pramudita bd. one of the stages of perfection [bhūmi].
pramuditacitta [citta] amnf pramuditacittā in a good mood; cheerful.
pramuditavat [vat] amnf pramuditavatī sa tisfait; réjoué.
pramuh [Pramuh] v. [4] pr. (pramúhyati) pp. (pramugdha, pramūḍha) to be stunned, to lose one's mind | to lose consciousness, to faint. ਸ਼ਸ਼ਫ pramūḍha |pp. pramuh| amnf pramūḍhā mad, insane.
pramṛj [Pramṛj] v. [2] pr. (pramārṣṭi) pp. (pramṛṣṭa) to clean, wash, sweep; to rub, polish. upacārātikramam pramārstumayamārambhah This act is to rectify the omission of reverence.
pramṛṣṭa |pp. pramṛj| amnf pramṛṣṭā polished, rubbed.

prameya [pfp. [1] pramā₁] amnf Pra meyā to be measured; measurable | phil. to be proven, to be established; provable; about which judgment must be formed — m. phil. [Nyāya] object of judgment or knowledge; there are twelve: the soul [ātman], the body [śarīra], the faculties [indriya], their objects [artha], consciousness [buddhi], mind [manas], activity [pravrtti], faults [doṣa₂], existence after the
death [pretyabhāva], the fruit of deeds [phala], the
misfortune [duhkha] and deliverance [apavarga] | phil. [Mīmāṃsā] instrument of correct knowledge — n. subject to be discussed; proposition to be established — f. Pra meyā ifc. id.
prameyakamalamārtaṇḍa [kamalamārtaṇḍa] m. bed. n.p. from the Prameyakamalamārtaņda "Sun of the lotus of knowledge", a work of Jain philosophy of knowledge due to Prabhācandra.
prameyatva [tva] n. provable; justifiability.
prameyadīpikā [dīpikā] f. lit. np. of the Pra meyadīpikā "Lights on knowledge", commentary on the Gītā bhāsya of Madhvācārya, due to Jayatīrtha.
prameyapradhāna | pradhāna | amnf prameya pradhānā which has judgment as its main object.
pramokṣa [act. pramuc] m. release; deliverance.
pramod [ca. pramud₁] v. [10] pr. (pramo dayati) rejoice.

pramodá [act. pramud₁] m. joy; Extreme pleasure | phil. [Sāmkhya] joy, one of the 8 perfections | myth. [MP.] np. by Pramoda “Pleasure”, a mānasaputra | myth. n.p. of Pramoda₁, a companion warrior of Skanda | myth. n.p. from nāga Pramoda₂; he perished at the sarpasattra of Janamejaya astr. n.p. of Pramoda₃ "Joyful", son of Nāradī personifying year 4 of a life cycle |samvatsara| pl. pramodās delights, pleasures. sapramodena cittena adv. with the Joyful spirit.
pramoha [act. pramuh] m. stupor, fainting | bewilderment.
pramohacitta [citta] amnf pramohacittā who has a bewildered, stupefied, dumbfounded mind.
pramohita [pp. ca. pramuh] amnf Pra mohitā bewildered, distraught.
pramluc [Pramluc] v. [1] pr. (pramlocati) to descend; to flow.
Pramlocā [act. pramluc] f. myth. n.p. of the apsaras Pramlocā.
prayaj [Prayaj₁] v. [1] pr. (prayajati) pr. r. (prayajate) to worship, to sacrifice to acc. .
prayat [Prayat₁] v. [1] pr. r. (prayatate) pp. (prayatta, prayatita) inf. (prayatitum) to strive, to apply oneself to (dat.); to attempt.

prayata [pp. prayam] amnf prayatā offered, presented, granted | soc. prepared for a religious rite; in pious dispositions, pure prudent, moderate — n. purity. mūtram kṛtvā purīṣam vā mūtrapurīṣalepān annalepān ucchiştalepān retasaś ca ye lepās tān prakṣālya pādau cācamya prayato bhavati [Apastamba] after urinating or defecating, and cleaning up the stains of urine and excrement, the stains of food and remains, as well as the stains of semen, after washing one's feet and rinsing one's mouth, one is ritually pure.
prayatātman [ātman] amnf prayatātmanī with a zealous heart.
prayatita [pp. prayat] amnf prayatitā attempted; to which one has applied oneself. prayatitam (impers.) one has taken pains to (loc.).
prayatitavya [pfp. [3] prayat] n. (impers.) we must strive to locate. | prayattavya id.
prayatta [pp. prayat] amnf prayattā oc cupé à.

prayatna |act. prayat| m. volition, intention to act | attempt; effort; perseverance | activity, voluntary act | phil. [Vaiśesika] the property [guna] of effort | phon. articulation; it can be internal [ābhyantara] or external [bāhya] — iic. barely. prayatnāt adv. with effort, with great care; barely, with difficulty. prayatnatas var. prayatnena, prayatnais adv. with effort; with zeal. sarve'sya prayatnāḥ sakalatāṃ yayuḥ his efforts were crowned with success.
prayatnasamvardhita [samvardhita] amnf prayatnasaṃvardhitā raised with care.
prayabh [prayabh] v. [1] pr. (prayabhati) (vulgar) cum.

prayam [prayam] v. [1] pr. (prayacchati) pp. (prayata) pf. (prati, sam) to stretch, extend; to give, offer, grant, send, produce. vikrayena prayam to sell. uttaram prayam to answer. śāpam prayam to cast a curse. yuddham prayam to give battle. viśam prayam to administer poison. buddhau prayam to present to the spirit.
prayas₁ [prayas] v. [4] pr. (prayásyati) pp. (prayasta) to strive to (dat.); to undertake.
prayas₁ [obj. prī] n. object of pleasure, delight; not. good meal.

prayā [prayā₁] v. [2] pr. (prayāti) pp. (prayāta) pf. (anu) to go, to set out; to walk towards, to go towards (acc. loc.); to run | to leave, to be on the way to, to advance; to wander | to assume (a form or a state), to fall into such a state | to reach, to attain, to succeed. diso prayā to spread out in all directions.

Prayāga |act. prayaj| m. geo. | "place of sacrifice"] np. of Prayāga, place of pilgrimage [kumbha mela at the confluence of the Yamunā and the Gangā, one of the four sacred places where a drop of soma from the churning of the sea of milk |kṣīrodamathana| (mod. Allāhābād) is said to have fallen from the mythical kumbha; it is the devīpīṭha of Kumudā; cf. trivenī, pratisthāna.
prayājá [obj. prayaj] m. SOC. preliminary offering; not. libations and invocations [mantra] preceding a Vedic soma sacrifice, or the ritual of re-establishing the fires.
prayāṇa [act. prayā] n. departure, the act of setting out; beginning, commencement | progress, advance | march, journey; not. march of an army, attack, invasion | (departure of the soul) death.
prayāta [pp. prayā] amnf prayātā gone; disappeared; died | arrived at (acc.).
prayātṛ [agt. prayā] amnf prayātrī who goes; who can go; who will go.
prayāsá [act. prayas₁] m. effort, work, perseverance.
prayu |prayu₂| v. |3| pr. (prayuyoti) pp. (prayuta) ppr. (prayucchat) to remove, to remove.
prayukta [pp. prayuj] amnf prayuktā ar arranged; thrown; drawn (sword); employed, used; suitable, appropriate | undertaken, begun.
práyukti [act. prayuj] f. impulse; motive; starting point; use.
prayucchat [ppr. prayu] amnf prayuc chatī that removes; that moves | giddy, inattentive.

prayuj [prayuj₁] v. [7] pr. (prayunákti) pr. r. (prayuńkté) pp. (prayukta) pf. (anu, vi, sam) to set in motion, to throw (des); to hurl against (dat. loc.) | to employ, to make use of, to practice; to accomplish, to do; to show, to exhibit | to undertake, to begin; to turn one's mind towards, to prepare for (dat.) — ca. (prayojayati) to throw, to hurl; to direct towards, to send to (loc.) — dés. r. (prayuyukṣate) to desire, to use, to need. jyotih śabdastejasi prayujyate the word jyotis is used in the sense of “light”. sukhārthe viṣayaśabdam na prayumjate they do not use the word vișaya in the sense of happiness.
prayuta n. math. one million.
prayudh [prayudh₁] v. [4] pr. r. (prayud hyate) v. [4] pr. (prayudhyati) pp. (prayuddha) to fight.
prayoktṛ [agt. prayuj] amnf prayoktrī [sg. nom. prayoktā, acc. prayoktāram] user; performer, artist; author; supplier, employer | actor, comedian, mime | gram. speaker; (opp. śrotr listener).
prayoktṛdharma [dharma] m. gram. [Vākyapadīya] linguistic expression of feelings. [9

prayoga [agt. prayuj] m. plan, project; act, effort; procedure | employment, use, utilization; treatment (medical) | phil. practice, opp. śāstra theory; syn. karman | soc. ritual manual; syn. paddhati | gram. voice of a verbal form (active kartari, passive karmani) | performance, execution; not. theatrical performance | loan, placement, usury — ifc. practice of (2nd century).
prayogapallava [pallava] m. gram. n.p. from Prayo gapallava, grammar due to Bhavanātha Miśra.
prayogavidhi [vidhi] m. phil. [Mīmāmsā] procedural ritual injunction.
prayogavisaya | visaya | m. gram. domain of use (of a word, of a phrase).
prayogaśālā [śālā] f. mod. laboratory.
Prayogasāra |sāra| mr. bed. n.p. of Prayogasāra, my Ved ritual manual. of Keśavasvāmī.
prayoj [ca. prayuj] v. [10] pr. (prayojayati) to throw, to cast; to direct towards, to send to loc. .

prayojaka [agt. prayuj] amnf prayojikā that produces, that causes; that leads to (g. iic.) — ifc. instigator, promoter of (iic.); that motivates (iic.) — m. author, composer; producer | gram. agent of the causative.
prayojakakartṛ | kartṛ | m. gram. agent inciting to do the action of a causative verb; opp. prayojyakartr the incited agent.

prayojana [act. prayuj] n. cause, motive; purpose, objective; object, intention; utility; utility of (i.) means of obtaining; need for (i.); use of (i.) | phil. [Nyāya] motivation for discussing a topic | gram. semantic role [kāraka] of purpose or motive, indicated by the dative — f. prajoyanā ifc. means of, motive for, purpose of (i.e.). prayojanena adv. with a definite intention; express. kena prayojanena for what reason? because of what? what is its use? kasmin prayojane id. kasmāt prayojanāt id. kasmai prayojāya id. kim prayojanam what is the use (i.)? taruṇā kim prayojanam what is the purpose of this tree? bhavatvetaih kusumaih prayojanam that these flowers be used. prayojanam atikram neglecting an opportunity.
prayojanakathana [kathana] n. introductory phrase of a work announcing its intention.
prayojanavat [vat] amnf prayojanavatī who pursues a goal, interested; intentional.

prayojya [pfp. [1] ca. prayuj] amnf prayojyā to launch (arrow, missile) | that which must be used or practiced | to appoint (to a post), that which must be appointed or commissioned; subordinate, collaborator, servant | that which must be represented (role in the theatre) | gram. subordinate agent (of a causative) — n. capital (loaned with interest).
prayojyakartṛ [kartṛ] m. gram. agent prompted to do the action of a verb in the causative; opp. prayojakakartr the inciting agent.
praruc [praruc₁] v. [1] pr. r. (prarocate) to shine, to gleam; to please — ca. (prarocayati) pp. (prarocita) to illuminate; to make shine; to make appreciated.
prarud [prarud₁] v. [2] pr. (praroditi) v. [6] pr. (prarudati) to start crying; to lament.
praruh [praruh₁] v. [1] pr. (praróhati) pp. (prarūdha) to grow, to sprout (plant); to increase, to prosper.
prarūḍha [pp. praruh] amnf prarūḍhā grown, developed, adult. prarūdhakeśa who wears long hair.
prarūp [prarūp] v. [10] pr. (prarūpayati) pp. (prarūpita) to expose, explain; to represent (not. on the stage), to express by gestures.
prarūpaṇa [act. prarūp] nf prarūpaṇā representation, exposition; explanation.
prarūpin [agt. prarūp] amnf prarūpiņī which represents, which explains.
praroc [ca. praruc] v. [10] pr. (praro cayati) pp. (prarocita) to illuminate; to make shine; to make appreciated, to recommend.

prarocana [agt. praruc] amnf praro canī which incites love; seductive — n. seduction; stimulation; praise — f. prarocanā soc. praise of the plot, made by the sūtradhāra during the prologue | pūrvaranga | of a theatrical performance.
prarocita [pp. That. praruc] amnf praro cita rented; appreciated; appreciated; recommended.
pralap [pralap] v. [1] pr. (pralapati) pp. (pra lapita) chat | to lament, to complain | chatter, babble; wander.
pralapana |act. pralap| n. act of speaking; pa roles, conversation | ramblings; delirium.
pralapita [pp. pralap] amnf pralapitā invoked, said — n. chatter; lamentation. সলভ্য pralabdha [pp. pralabh] amnf pralabdhā taken, seized; deceived.

pralabh [pralabh] v. [1] pr. r. (pralabhate) pp. (pralabdha) pf. (vi) seize, take, get deceived, make fun of. সল্ভ pralamb [Pralamb] v. [1] pr. r. (pralambate) pp. (pralambita) hang. সিলাদৰ Pralamba |agt. pralamb | amnf pralambā which hangs; leaning forward — m. myth. n.p. of the dai tya Pralamba "Bent", killed by Balarāma.
pralambapāda [pāda] amnf pralambapādā ["who has dangling feet"] sitting in the European style.
pralambapādāsana |āsana| n. seated posture on a seat, in the European style.
Pralambabāhu [bāhu] m. lit. [KSS.] np. of the young brahmin Pralambabāhu "Dangling Arms", powerful servant of Naravahanadatta.
pralambāri [ari] myth. n.p. pralambāri "Enemy of Pralamba", epith. of Balarāma.
pralambita [pp. pralamb] amnf Pra lambitā pendant.
pralaya |act. pralī| m. dissolution, destruction, annihilation | phil. [Sāṃkhya] end of a kalpa, destruction of the world giving way to the night of Brahmā; cf. mahāpralaya.
pralāpá |act. pralap| m. chatter | lamentation, jeremiad; incoherent speech, cha rabia, delirium.
pralāpana |act. pralap| n. the act of learning to speak.
pralī [Pralī] v. [4] pr. r. (pralyate) pp. (pralīna) to dissolve, to vanish; die.
pravaka [agt. pru] amnf pravikā which goes repeatedly; which goes well.
pravaktṛ [agt. pravac] amnf pravaktrī enunciator, orator; narrator | soc. promoter of a school of thought | phil. one who reveals or proclaims the word.
pravac [Pravac] v. [2] pr. (pravakti) pp. (prokta) abs. (Pra_ucya) pf. (sam) to say; to announce, to proclaim; to explain.

Śrīnagara) | bd. np. of Pravara, interlocutor of Buddha at his sermon of Vaiśālī₁ — f. Pravarā geo. np. of the river Pravarā, tributary of the Godāvarī. āṅgīrasagotrotpanna āśvalāyanasūtra rk śākhādhyāyī arjunaśarmā'ham bho abhivādaye Endowed with the lineage of the 3 sages Angīrasa, Ambarīsa and Yauvanāśva, from the clan of the radiant singers, following the rites of the lineage of Asvala, and studying the branch of hymns of the Veda, I, Arjuna the Brahmin, respectfully greet you.

Pravarasena [senā] m. hist. Pravarasena "of the eminent army", np. of princes of Kaśmīra; Pravarasena II created the city of Pravarasenapura (mod. Śrīnagara) around the 1st century | hist. np. of King Pravarasena₁ of the Vākāṭakās dynasty (270–330); this conqueror ruled over all of the Deccan and a large part of North India; he had the title of Emperor [samrāj] | hist. np. of Pravarasena₂, king of the Vākāṭakās (400–415); his capital was Nandi vardhana, then its eponym Pravarapura; Setubandha₁ is attributed to him.
pravareśvara [īśvara] m. geo. np. of the temple of Pra vareśvara in Pravarapura.
pravará₂ [act. pravṛ₁] m. cover; upper garment. vrnotecchādane gram. [Pāṇini] (the suffix ghañ) after the root vr₁ (preceded by the prefix Pra) is used to designate a cover.

prava [pravā₂] v. [2] pr. (pravāti) pp. (pravāta) to blow, to blow; to exhale.
pravac [pravac] amnf eloquent | talkative, boastful.

pravata [pp. pravata] amnf pravatata winded; battered by the winds — n. draft; storm.

pravada [pravada] m. speaking, utterance | discussion, palaver, gossip, rumor, unfounded rumors, slander (concerning g. ) | words of defiance (before a fight) — ifc. the act of pretending to be (i.c.) | gram. inflected form arbit traire de (i.c.) — f. pravada ifc. something concerning (i.c.). pravadam adr. greetings.
pravara [act. pravṛ₁] m. blanket; woolen garment; outer garment; syn. pravará₂. স্বাল pravala var. prabāla [pravāla] mn bour geon, young shoot | coral.
pravasa [act. pravas] m. stay abroad; foreign residence, exile; absence from one's home; emigration.
pravasin [agt. pravas] amnf pravasinī traveler; resident abroad.

pravahamaya [maya] amnf pravahamayī lu cide, avisé, sensé.
pravahaka [agt. pravah] amnf pravahikā that carries — act. f. pravahikā med. diarrhea.

pravah [act. pravah] amnf pravahī that transports; that carries away — m. phil. [BU.] np. of the prince [kṣatriya] Pravāhaṇa Jaivali; he taught the doctrine of reincarnation to the sage Aruni — n. act of carrying away; evacuation — f. pravahī med. sphincter muscle.
pravicaya [act. pravaci] m. investigation, research, examination.
pravacal [pravical] v. [1] pr. (pra vicálati) pp. (pravicalita) to stir, tremble, move; to move away from — ca. (pravicālayati) to move, to agitate, to shake.
pravici [pravici] v. [5] pr. (pravicinoti) pp. (pravicita) to search; to investigate, to examine.
pravitata [pravitata] amnf pravitatā extended, spread out; wide | undertaken; arranged.

pravid [pravid₁] v. [2] pr. (pravetti) to know, to understand — ca. (pravedayati) ca. (pravedayate) to inform, to make known, to communicate. yatkarmino na pravedayanti rāgāt [MO.] men of action do not understand the truth, because of their passions.
pravibhakta [pp. pravibhaj] amnf pravibhaktā separated, divided, distributed; distributed; scattered | that has received its share — ifc. divided into, made up of (iic.).

pravibhaj [pravibhaj] v. [1] pr. (pravibha jati) pp. (pravibhakta) separate, divide, distribute, allocate | separate, discern. pravibhajyātmanātmānam sṛṣṭvā bhāvān prthagvidhān | sarveśvaraḥ sarvamayaḥ svapne bhoktā pravartate | [Bhartṛhari] By dividing the Self by the Self, having successively emitted beings of each kind, the all-encompassing Universal Lord unfolds, taking pleasure in his dream.

pravibhāga [act. pravibhaj] m. division; distribution, classification | portion. pravibhāge adv. [Bhart.rhari] in the waking state; opp. avibhāge. pravibhāge yathā kartā tayā kārye pravartate avibhāge tathā saiva kāryatvenāvatisthate [Bhartṛhari] Just as in the waking state the agent uses (speech) to (produce) an effect, in the dream state it is speech that remains as the effect.
pravimuc [pravimuc] v. [6] pr. (pra vimuñcati) pp. (pravimukta) to let go, to deliver, to free; to abandon.

pravimṛś [pravimṛś] v. [1] pr. (pravimṛśati) pp. (pravimrsta) abs. (pravimrsya) to reflect on, consider, examine; to deliberate. pravimrśya ind. having reflected, having considered; having deliberated.
pravilī [pravilī] v. [4] pr. r. (pravilīyate) to dissolve, melt; disappear — ca. (pravilāpayati) to dissolve into, melt into loc. .
pravilup [pravilup] v. [6] pr. (pravilumpati) pp. (pravilupta) to abandon, to renounce.

pravivic [pravivic] ps. (pravivicyate) pp. (pravivikta) to separate; to examine.

praviś [praviś₁] v. [6] pr. (praviśati) pr. r. (pravisáte) pp. (pravista) pfp. (pravesya, pravestavya) abs. (praviśya) pf. (anu) to enter; to penetrate, to go into (acc.); to arrive in (acc. loc. | lit. to enter the scene (theater) | to have sexual relations with (acc.) | to begin, to enter, to take; to apply oneself to — ca. (praveśayati) intro to lead (into (2 acc.)). praviśāmi here I am. praveśyatām let him be brought in. agnim pravis to mount the funeral pyre. dine dine hi bhūtāni praviśanti yamālayam |Mah.| Every day truly the departed enter the realm of the dead.

pravihṛ [pravihṛ] pf. (sam) [unused without pf.].

(abhi, sam) to roll; to set in motion, to advance; to go to | to come from, to originate from; to occur, to follow, to take place; to begin, to undertake, to start, to proceed to (inf. acc.); to act; to attend to (dat. loc.); to procure something (acc.) for someone (g.) | to flow, to continue — ca. (pravartáyati) cf. pravart. prāvartata śapathāya he undertook to take an oath. śivāj jñānam pravartate Knowledge proceeds from Shiva. tasyāḥ sahasā prāvartatāśrudhārā She burst into tears.

Pravṛtti [act. pravṛt] f. forward movement, impulse; progression | progress, evolution; mani

celebration | origin, source | activity, effort, action phil. engagement in the world, active path (opp. nivrtti) | myth. np. of Pravrtti "Cogitation", personifying mental activity, épouseśakti of Ma nas the Mind | tendency; inclination towards the angle loc. iic. | information, news | soc. regional costume style | conduct, practice; fate, destiny | gram. application of a rule; validity of a rule, the fact that a form is produced. madhupravrttih coming of spring.

pravrttinimitta [nimitta] n. gram. rule of use of a word; cause of production of a form; connotation; semantic condition for the use of a word; argument in support of the choice of the meaning of an ambiguous word | phil. [Nyāya] cause of application of a term.
pravrttibheda | bheda | m. gram. ambiguity between two rules.
pravrttivisaya | visaya | m. gram. object of the action.

pravṛddha [pp. pravṛdh] amnf pravṛddhā grown, developed; increased, augmented | large, strong, in tense; numerous; swollen (wave, ocean) | prosperous, powerful | myth. [Rām.] np. of the king of Ayodhyā pravṛddha "prosperous", son of Raghu, epithet of the king
cannibal | puruṣādaka | Kalmāṣapāda; he is the father of Śankhana.

pravṛdh [pravṛdh₁] v. [1] pr. r. (pravardhate) pp. (pravrddha) to increase, grow, prosper — ca. (pravardhayati) to enlarge, increase, raise, increase; to raise, to make prosper. daśaputrasamā kanyā daśaputrān pravardhayan yatphalam labhate martyastallabhyam kanyayai kayā | [SP.] a daughter is worth 10 sons; the merits a man obtains by raising 10 boys can be obtained by raising a single daughter.
pravṛṣ [pravṛṣ] v. [1] pr. (pravarṣati) pp. (pravṛṣṭa) to start to rain, to rain; to cover with i. .
praveṇi [praveṇi] f. hairstyle of widows and women separated from their husbands.

praveśa [act. praviś] m. act of entering; arrival, penetration; beginning; entrance | place of entry, access; admission | intrusion into (loc. g. ii.); inopportune intervention — ifc. lit. introduction to (ii.). praveśam kr enter.
praveśānumati [anumati] f. mod. Visa.
praveśaka [agt. praviś] m. lit. interlude scene in the theatre, where secondary characters comment on the action — ifc. introduction to (iic.) — f. praveśikā id. (name of works).
praveśana [act. praviś] n. entry, penetration into (loc. g. iic.) | sexual act | introduction to (loc.).
praveśita [pp. ca. praviś] amnf praveśitā introduced, brought into | led to (not. sleep) | installed, enthroned — f. praveśitā pregnant woman.
praveśya [pfp. [1] praviś] amnf praveśyā where one can enter; accessible | where one must enter.

pravestavya [pfp. [3] praviś] amnf pravestavyā that can be entered, accessible, open that must or can enter, that can be admitted — n. (impers.) one must enter (into (loc.)). na pravestavya amn forbidden access — n. (impers.) it is forbidden to enter.
pravyath [pravyath] pr. r. (pravyathate) pp. (pravyathita) to be worried, to tremble; to be afraid of (g.) — ca. (pravyathayati) to torment, to frighten.
pravyathita [pp. pravyath] amnf pra vyathitā afflicted; in distress.
pravyāhr [pravyāhr] v. [1] pr. (pravyāharati) pp. (pravyāhṛta) to pronounce, to say, to speak.

pravraj [pravraj] v. [1] pr. (pravrájati) pp. (pravrajita) to advance, to set out; to wander soc. to abandon one's home (to become a wandering ascetic) | to emigrate.

pravrajya [act. pravraj] n. emigration — f. pravrajyā departure from home; abandonment of one's home; renunciation of the world | bd. first act of a novice wanting to become a monk and leaving his family; first level of ordination | wandering, not. of a monk bd. | emigration
pravrajyavastu |vastu₁| n. bd. n.p. of pravrajya vastu, section of the Vinayasūtra relating to the first level of ordination of a bd monk.

praśastatva |vat| n. Excellency.

philosopher [Vaiśeṣika] (~550–600); he is the author of the Padārthadharmasamgraha, also called Praśastapādabhāsya.

praśastavya [pfp. [3] praśaṃs] amnf praśastavyā worthy of praise.

praśām | praśam | amnf tranquil, pa cified; unharmed.

praśravana n. cf. prasravana.
